tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sngags kyi klog thabs 'bras bu 'byung ba'i me tog bzhugs/ /

༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rig sngags bzlog par bzlas gyur na/ /dad med rnams la 'dod don med/ /dad pa yod kyang dngos grub ring*/ /de la klog thabs mdor bsdu na/ /ā li kā li gug skyed bcas/ /de la slob dpon ngag bzhin du/ kha mig 'dris par yun ring bslab/ /klog thabs rim bzhin mi slob par/ /sngags 'bru rnams la 'di ci zhes/ /zer ba'i rgyu med 'bras 'dod pa/ /rmongs rnams yun ring don med 'gyur | | a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ dbyangs yig bcu drug go /ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ gsal byed sum cu rtsa bzhi'o | | thog mar dbyangs yig bcu drug la/ /a ni drang po i bkug pa/ /u ni smad pa zhes bya ste/ /de dag ring thung gnyis gnyis yod/ /ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ zhes bya ba | | ma ning gi ni yi ge bzhi/ /de la ring thung gnyis gnyis yod/ /e ni bsgreng ba'i nga ro ste/ /ai ni bsgreng zhing bkug pa yin/ /o ni bstod pa zhes bya ste | | au ni bstod de smad pa yin/ /aṃ ni sna ldan zhes bya ste/ /aḥni rnam par bcad pa'o/ /nga ro drang po las byung ba/ /ka nas brtsams te k+ṣa yi bar/ / gsal byed yi ge sum cu bzhi/ /skad gdangs yul gyi skad kyis dbyung*/ /gal te skad gdangs bcos pa na/ /rnar mi snyan cing brjod nor 'byung*/ /rgya skad phal cher lce rtse las/ /'byung zhing brjod pa rab tu myur/ /skad gdangs mgrin pa phra zhing snyan/ /bod skad phal cher lce dbus las/ /'byung zhing brjod pa dal ba yin/ /mgrin pa sbaum gyur kha che dang*/ /ur+yan yul yang de dang 'dra/ /bod ni khyad par skad thung zhing*/ /ring thung khyad par 'ga' yang med/ /de la 'a med thung ba ste/ /thung dang drag po nor mi bya/ /ai e 'i ra bklag pa ste/ /bsgreng zhing bkug pa yin phyir ro/

/au o'u gang du bris kyang rung*/ /o 'ur brjod de bstod smad phyir/ /sna ldan rnam par bcad pa yang*/ /ring bar sgrar ni brjod par bya/ /ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa ṣa drug /gha dzha dha bha k+ṣa ste lnga/ /de ltar yi ge bcu gcig po | | bod la gtan nas med pa yin/ /rgya gar ba la'ang de dag la/ /yi ge log dang ha btags med/ /'on kyang bod kyis brjod shes phyir/ /sngon gyi byang chub sems dpas mdzad/ /de ltar ta tha da na sha/ lce rnal las 'byung de dag la | | lce rtse bzlog ste brjod pa yis/ /ṭa ṭha ḍa ṇa ṣa rnams 'byung*/ /gha sogs ha btags yi ge lnga/ /ga dza ḍa da ba lnga la/ /ha sgra cung zad 'byung ba la/ / dgongs te ha btags yi ge mdzad/ /gha la mkha' 'dra dzha 'tsha' 'dra/ /ḍha ni 'aṭh 'dra dha 'tha' 'dra/ /bha ni 'pha' dang 'dra bar bklag /ha sgra mi gsal cung zad ldan/ /k+ṣa ni ka ṣa yin mod kyi/ /mi shes rnams kyis khya 'drar bklag /sha ṣa sa yi yi ge gsum/ /skabs kyis lce la gang bder bklag /ka tshan gyi ni klad kor nga*/ /tsa tshan nya yin ṭa tshan ṇa/ /ta tshan na yin de gsum ka /bod kyis nar brjod pa mtshan ma/ /a dang k+ṣa yi klad kor rnams/ /ngar bklag pa ni mchog yin no/ /da ni brtsegs pa brjod par bya/ /dper na tiṣ+ṭha tis thra bzhin | | gug skyed can gcig byung gyur na/ /phral te gug skyed kun la sbyar/ / dper na t+yu la tu yu'am/ /ṣ+ṭhi la ṣi thri ji bzhin no/ /gal te phral te klog pas na | | ci phyir phral nas mi 'bri zhes/ /rgol na bod skad kyang mtshungs zhes/ /de gnyis khyad par med par bsgre/ /gsang sngags kyi ni rgyud rnams las/ /yi ge mang po brtsegs pa yod/ /de ni sa bon yin pa'i phyir/ /dus gcig mi brjod phral te brjod/ /tsa tsha dza la ya sta btags/ /bod kyis ca cha ja bzhin bklag / gug skyes can yang de bzhin te/ /dper na ts+yai tsa yi bzhin/ /ta tha da sogs ya sta byung*/ /e sgra ldan par phral zhing bklag /dper na t+yai te ye bzhin/

/th+yai la the ye ji bzhin no/ /dz+nya zhes bya ba'i yi ge la/ /bod kyis gnya' zhes bya bar bklag | ṣ+ṇa ṣ+ta ṣ+ṭha zhes bya ba la/ /sha log sha rnal gang byung yang*/ /sa dang 'dra bar bya ba ste/ /snra s+t+ra zhes brjod pas 'grub/ /s+t+rai yā dhā lta bu la// s+t+re'i yā dhā ru bklags pas 'grub/ /de la sogs pa bsam mi khyab/ /sngags ky-i klog thabs ma shes na/ /'dir mang dris pas ci zhig phan/ /de bas sngags brjod thabs la 'bad/ /sngags kyi klog thabs 'bras bu 'byung ba'i me tog ces bya ba lo tsā ba kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis sbyar ba rdzogs so// // ༄༅/ /sgra nye bar bsdu ba bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bzlas brjod 'bri dang klog sogs la/ /nor 'khrul ma dag bsam mi khyab/ /blo gros mig dang ldan pa yi/ /shes ldan rnams kyis thos pa sbyongs/ /rgya dpe oṃ la ring cha med/ /'a ā+oṃ/ btags nor zhes bla mas paṇa chen shākya shrīs gsungs/ /'bru gsum āḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ la tsheg drag thob/ /nga ro ring char bklags pas nor/ /gnod sum+bha ni sum+bha/ mdzes nges par gnod mdzes la/ /gnod mdzes suṃ bha ni dgag tshig yin pas nor| khog ces bya bas nor/ /bir+wa pa ngan pa/ zhes bya ba la/ /bīr+ya pa brtson 'grus/ ru nor ba yod/ /paṇ+ḍi ta gnas lnga rig pa/ zhes bya ba la/ /pam pi ta ru 'bod pa mthong | | tshur gshegs e h+ye hi/ i ha hi ru 'bod/ /mtha' can swā hā/ la sogs yan lag saha/ gcod/ /rnam sras bai/ la sogs sa bon la/ /be zhes bya bar 'bod pa mthong*/ khro rgyal mi g.yo'i sngags la ni/ /log lnga ṇa ḍa ṣa ṇa ṭa/ yod de rnal mar na da sha na ta/ nor/ /rdo rje phur pa kyi la ya/ /sgra dang rgyud las gsungs pa med/ /phur pa'i sgra ni kā+-i+i la ya/ khams gsum rnam rgyal sngags trai lo kya bi dza ya/ la ni/ dus gsum s+t+rai yā ngh+wa/ zhes bya'i sgra dod la/ /e dang e dang 'a/ a ldan s+t+re ya dh+wa/ chad pas nor/

/'chi med a mṛ ta/ dug asmi ta/ tu nor ba yod// sdig bshags kaṃ ka ni/ bya rog kā ka ni/ skrod par nor/ /gtsug tor ta thā ga toṣ+ṇai ṣa si tā| dkar mo'i mtshan don la/ /u ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + smad pas ur ) ta thā ga taṣ+ṇi sha zhes chad pas thams cad nor/ /mkha' 'gro ḍā ki dha kir bklags pas nor/ /rnam rtog shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na/ 'gog pa'i tshig la ni/ /snya nar kha che gnya' ma ga nghā pas 'gya ru klog 'bod pa shin tu nor/ /dbang phyug ī shwar/ wa sta sha ra/ chad pas nor/ /sems dpa' sa twa/ wa sta sa ta/ chad pas nor/ /bcom ldan bha ga ba gar bklags pas nor// snying po yi ge 'bru brgya la/ /yid can ma nu pā la ya/ skyong bar mdzod cig la// yid ni ma nu pa la yar/ skyo bar nor ba yod/ /brtan pa tiṣ+ṭha/ gnas par tiṣ+ta/ nor ba yod | | bde ba ḍi ḍho/ grangs kyi gsum tri to/ du nor/ /shin tu bde dang su toṣ+yo/ myur du su poṣ+yo/ la/ ṣa la su to sho ya sta su pa sho chad pas nor/ /rjes su chags par a nu rāk+to/ mdzod cig la/ /rak+tar nor ba 'ba' zhig mthong*/ /dngos grub sing+ngham+me pra yats+tsha/ stsal du gsol zhes la/ /sid ti ma mer bklags pas nor/ /tsa sdai ṭa sde tsaṃ ṭaṃ taṃ/ ta sde gsum/ /thig le nga ru bklags pas nor/ /rten 'brel niro dha zhes pa la/ ṣāñtsa yo ni/ ṣān zhes pa la/ ṣā na ta thā ga to zhes par sbyar/ snying po spel mar klog/ bod yul rmongs pa'i chos lugs 'di/ /sgra skad ngharmā/ rgya min bod min klog dar ma| sangs rgyas bung+nghaḥ la ni 'byung bhūta/ por 'bod/ rnam par snang mdzad bai ro tsa na| g.yu bi ro tsa/ ru 'bod/ /bya khyung ga ru ḍa/ la ni snying rjer kā ru ṇa/ 'bod/ /rdo rje badz+ra rdo 'jong ba ra badz+ra ra rdo nar du/ /'dzin 'chang pā ṇi/ lag na chu ru pa ni/ 'bod | 'phags pa ār+ya/ a rgyar bklags pas 'khrul/ /'byung gtor ād+ya nut+pan+na| ār+ya nud pan du/ /bklags pas 'phags pa'i pho mtshan chod / / ces pa nor bas rab tu 'khrul/

/yin ni ād+ya nut+pan yin/ /de sogs nor ba mang mthong bas/ /thaus pa dang ni ldan par mdzod/ /sgra nye bar bsdus pa'i tshigs su bcad pa skad gnyis smra ba kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sbyar ba'o// ༄༅/ /tshig gi gter zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ pa da ni nghiḥ bod skad du/ tshig gi gter/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dpal la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam dbyangs mi zad tshig gi gter/ /'gro ba skyob mdzad la btud de/ /mkhas pa rnams kyi mdzod gyur pa/ /tshig gi gter 'di bdag gis dbye/ /byang phyogs 'di na tshig la mkhas pa med/ /legs par shes nas 'chad pa kho bo tsam/ /rtags kyi dbye ba phal cher 'dir mi 'jug /'on kyang bod la mkho ba mdo tsam bsdu/ / sangs rgyas spyi'i mtshan/ sangs rgyas bde gshegs thams cad mkhyen/ /chos kyi rgyal po de bzhin gshegs/ /kun tu bzang po bcom ldan 'das/ /rgyal ba bdud 'dul 'jig rten 'dul/ /mngon shes drug ldan stobs bcu pa/ /gnyis med gsung ba rnam 'dul mdzad/ /thub dbang dpal stug ston pa thub/ / shāka thub kyi mtshan| shāka thub shākya'i seng ge dang*/ /don grub zas gtsang sras gau tam/ /sgyu 'phrul sras po nyi ma'i gnyen/ /gzhan yang skyob pa nyid gzigs dang*/ /bu ram shing pa la sogs pa'o/ / mtho ris kyi ming*/ gnas bzang sdig med sum rtsen dang*// lha yi 'jig rten skabs gsum gnas/ /rol pa gsum gnas mtho ris ming*// gzhan yang grub pa'i gnas sogs yod/ / lha spyi'i ming*/ 'chi med rgas med skabs gsum lha/ /rnam sras bcud ldan tshigs bzang dang*/ /yid bzang sum rtsen dbang ldan dang*/ /mtho ris gnas dang mi sbyin skyes/ /mkhar nyal legs bris mi sbyin dga'/ /mi sbyin bu dang ṛ yig bu/ /mi rmi mi 'chi bdud rtsi zas/ /me zhal mchod sbyin zas ngag mtshon/ /sbyin byed dgra dang tshigs bzang ngo*/ / de'i rigs las byung ba'i ming*/

rig 'dzin chu byung gnod sbyin dang*/ /srung ma dri za mi 'am ci | | sha za grub pa gsang ba pa/ /'byung po 'di dag lha las byung*/ / lha ma yin gyi ming*| lha min sbyin byed sbyin skyes dung ( ¡¶ zha ¡· bu ) / /gzhu rgyal dang ni dbang po'i dgra | khu ba'i slob ma sbyin ma'i bu/ /sngon gyi lha dang lha yi dgra/ / tshangs pa'i ming*/ tshangs pa bdag skyes lha las rgan/ /mes po mchog gnas gser gyi mngal/ rang byung gdong bzhi 'jig rten dbang*/ /byed po sdang byed chu skyes mngal/ /sgrub byed 'byin byed pad+ma'i stan/ /sna tshogs 'byin byed skye rgu'i bdag khyab 'jug gi ming*| khyab 'jug mi yi theg pa dang*/ /nag po biṣ+tā ra thos dang*/ /rtul mo'i bu dang thi gu'i lto/ /dbang po'i dbang phyug sgra gcan gsod/ /sbrang rtsi'i bu dang rang las skyes/ /sbyin byed dgra bo pad dkar mig /mkha' lding rgyal mtshan glang rdzir grags/ /mi 'dzag gos ser rwa gzhu can/ / ¡Ã sna tshogs ( ¡¶ zha ¡· - sna tshogs ) sde can 'gro ba 'joms ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + pa dang ) / /nye dbang dbang pos brten pa dang | | lag pa bzhi pa 'khor lo'i lag /pad+ma'i lte ba sbrang rtsi'i dgra/ /nor lha'i bu dang rnam gsum gnon/ /lha mo dga' byed dpa' bo'i rgyud/ /dpal gyi bdag po skyes bu'i mchog /me tog phreng ldan stobs ldan 'joms/ /'khar ba'i dgra 'og dbang las skyes/ /kun skyob 'joms byed shes gsal thul/ /dpal be'us mtshan pa'i rin chen dga'/ /stobs bzang dang ni rab 'phyang gsod/ / stobs lha mi 'dzag sngon skyes dang*/ /nam gru dga' byed dga' byed dang*/ / 'dod skyong gshol mtshon gos sngon can/ /snar ma'i bu dang tā las mtshan/ / legs 'gugs thong ldan gtun shing can/ /dus ldan 'joms dang lag na gshol | | stobs ldan zhes bya de yi spun/ khyab 'jug bu'i ming*/ /myos byed yid srub gsod byed dang*/ /rab stobs dang ni ¡Ã nya yi ( ¡¶ zha ¡· nyi ma'i

) tog /tshangs 'joms lus med 'dod ldan snyems/ /dran pa 'dod pa mda' lnga pa/ /sdom pa'i dgra dang yid las skyes/ /gzhan las skye med me tog mda'/ /dga' ma'i bdag po me tog gzhu/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan bdag las byung*/ / 'dod lha'i bu'i ming*/ sna tshogs tog ldan tshangs pa skyes/ /nyag phran bdag po ma 'gags pa/ / dpal mo'i ming*/ mtshon byed pad+ma'i gzhal med khang*/ /pad+ma can dang ka ma la/ /dpal dang 'phrog byed dga' ba dung*/ /dbyangs bdag lnga skyes 'khor lo dang*/ / legs mthong phyag mtshan la/ sa mos be con dang/ /ral gri dga' byed sa rengs dang | | nor bu zhes kyang grags pa yin/ / mkha' lding ming*/ 'dab ldan dug 'joms skar mig bu/ /rnam dul las skyes klu mthar byed/ /mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug 'dab bzang dang*/ khyab 'jug shing rta lto 'gro za/ / dbang phyug gi ming*/ bde 'byung dbang phyug phyugs bdag dang*/ /mchog dga' dang ni mdung thogs dang | dbang phyug dbang phyug chen po dang*/ /mthar gsod dbang ldan bde byed dang | | gtsug na zla ba 'byung po'i dbang*/ /dgra sta'i dum bu gangs ri'i bdag/ ri yi bdag po sim byed dang*/ /pags pa'i gos can 'chi las rgyal/ /'joms byed bdag po drag shul can/ /dpal mgrin 'gul gnag ral pa can/ /thod pa 'chang ba g.yon phyogs lha/ /mig mi bzang dang lha chen po/ /ri yi ku ba mig gsum pa/ /kun mkhyen ral pa'i khur bu can/ /za bo dran pa 'phrog byed dang*// 'jigs byed gsum lha gaṅgā 'dzin/ /grong gsum mthar byed long ba'i dgra/ / mchod sbyin 'joms byed nam mkha'i skra/ khyu mchog rgyal mtshan srid pa 'jigs// rtag gnas drag po u ma'i bdag /gzhan las dran dgra rtse gsum can/ / mgrin sngon la sogs grags pa yod/ /ral pa bcings pa ¡Ã ka ra dha ( ¡¶ zha ¡· chus gang ba ) / /de yi 'khor ni 'joms byed do/ / u ma'i ming*/ u ma kā t+yā'i bu mo dang | | dkar mo nag mo gser ldan ma/

/dbang ldan ( ¡¶ zha ¡· mo ) zhi ma srid pa ma | | drag mo gsod ma lo ma med/ /kun la bkra shis ri khrod ma/ /gtum mo sim byed rdzong na gnas/ /kun gyi ma rnams btsun mo'i ming*/ / tshogs bdag ming*/ log 'dren bgegs kyi rgyal po dang*/ /tshogs kyi bdag po ma gnyis pa/ /he ram+ba dang lto 'phyang ba/ /mche ba gcig pa glang po'i gdong*/ / smin drug gi ming*/ sde chen dang ni smin drug bu/ /'dam bu'i tshal skyes gdong drug pa/ /ri khrod ma dga' dud mo dang*/ / ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· + aṃ gī ghu har gi dpung bsrung*/ / ) sde dpon dang ni mang po skyes/ /sgrol byed 'dul ba sa ga skyes/ /gtsug phud can zhon ma drug pa/ / mdung thogs gzhon nu khrung khrung 'joms/ / brgya byin gyi ming*/ dbang po dang ni ma ru tān | | ma gha las skyes 'od khyab dang*/ /smin pa 'dul byed bi ḍo dzāḥ /rgan las thos su nā shī ra/ /pu ru hū taḥgrong 'joms dang*/ /dziṣ+ṇu rli kha ra ṣa bhaḥ nus ldan mchod sbyin brgya pa dang*/ /mtho ris bdag po legs skyob dang*/ /ri 'joms dbyig ldan rdo rje can/

/gnas bdag char 'bebs sgrib skyob 'joms | | lha yi bdag po stobs kyi dgra/ /bde sogs bdag po rmugs 'joms dang*/ /'phrog byed rta dang swa ra ṇu/ /ngur 'jug dang ni mi gtong gsod | | mi nyams bzod dka' gzhan snyems theg /mig stong kun 'joms sprin la zhon/ /mtho ris gnas pa'o gzhan las ni/ /ko'u shi ka la sogs pa grags | de'i btsun mo sogs kyi ming*/ /de yi btsun mo dbang mo dang*/ /bden smra mthong las skyes zhes grags/ /de yi grong khyer 'chi med gnas/ khang bzangs rnam rgyal mdun sa ni/ /chos bzang gnas ni dga' ba'i tshal/ /de yi glang chen mtsho byung dang*/ /sprin gyi glang po sgra sgrogs dang*/ /sgra 'byin sprin grol ma yi khyo/ kha lo ba ni mā ta li/ /de'i rta 'thor thos mtshon cha ni/ /rdo rje lag nyal 'jigs byed dang*/ /dag byed dang ni rtse brgya pa/ /sgra can bde ldan bsgyings 'gro dang*/ / za byed ces bya nam mkha' la/ /'gro ba'i theg pa bi mā na/ /btung bya bdud rtsi btung bde yin/ /chu bo dal 'bab mtho ris klung*/ /nam mkha'i gaṅgā lha rings so | | 'tsher byed lhun po gser gyi ri/ /rin chen rdul brtsegs lha yi gnas/ / ljon shing yid mos rgya mtsho skyes/ /legs rgyas dang ni dpag bsam shing*/ / dbang po tshim byed rnam pa lnga*/ /kun 'gyed gzhon nu rnam byed bu/ /swarbaid+yā dang rgod ma'i bu/ /mi bden med dang tha skar skyes/ /nad sel zhes bya lha mo rnams// chu byung swa sh+yā rbe urba sī sogs/ / me lha'i ming*/ me dang 'khyogs 'bar bsreg za dang | | nor las rgyal dang chu'i skye gnas/ /gsal byed skyes thob lus 'phel dang | | lam nag skems byed shing las 'phel/ /'bar ba'i skra can snga dro 'bar | | rten za 'od chen 'phrog byed dang*/ /dag byed 'tsho byed rta dmar can// rlung gi grogs po gtsug phud can/ /rtse zan gser gyi khu ba dang*/ /bsreg za sreg byed mtshun thob byed/

/dul 'gro 'od 'grib 'od bdun pa/ /'od gsal 'od bkra 'od nor can/ / rgod ma kha sogs kyi ming*/ chu mkhris brang skyes rgod ma can// me 'o me 'od 'bar dang bcings/ /mchod bya der 'gro nyal yur dang*/ /'phros 'gro me yi zegs ma dang*/ /yongs su gdung ba tshad pa can/ / gshin rje'i ming*/ chos kyi rgyal po pha yi bdag /mtshun 'jug mthar byed rab song rgyal/ /zhi sgrub ya mu na yi spun/ /dus 'dzin gsod byed bka' sdod dang*/ /nyi ma'i bu dang mtshun la rol/ / srin po'i ming*/ srul po za byed sha za dang*/ khrag 'thung kun gsod mtshan mor rgyu/ /mtshan mor spyod dang snyan par bstod/ /gsod byed bdag skyes mthar 'gro sbyin/ /bsod nams skye bo phyogs kyi bu/ /mthar 'gro dang ni bsrung ba pa/ / chu lha'i ming*/ rab sems mchog ster zhags pa can/ /chu spyod bdag po chu bdag dang*/ / rlung lha'i ming*/ dbugs 'byin reg byed ma bdag nyal/ /rtag 'gro dri len rta dmar can/ /dri bzhon gnas med myur 'gro dang*/ /sim byed sim pa yang dag rgyu/ /'gro ba'i ngang tshul skye 'gro'i srog /mnga' ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· mkha' ) bdag dag byed rab 'joms so/ / lus kyi rlung sogs kyi ming*/ srog dang thur ser mnyam gnas dang*/ /gyen rgyu khyab byed lus kyi rlung*/ / myur ba'i ming*/ myur ba nyid sgrol shugs ldan 'gro/ /mgyogs pa la gor skyen pa yud/ /thabs gcig mi sdod de ma thag / rtag tu'i ming*/ rtag tu rgyun tu mi ngal ba/ /rgyun mi 'chad dang bar med sogs/ / rnam thos sras kyi ming*/ lus ngan grogs po mig gsum pa/ / gsang ba'i bdag po gnod sbyin rgyal/ /mi yi chos ldan nor sbyin rgyal/ /rgyal po dang ni nor gyi bdag /mi 'am ci dbang rnam thos sras/ /'od ( ¡¶ zha ¡· 'dod ) yangs bu pho mi la zhon/ /mchod sbyin dmar ser mig ya can/ /dpal ster dbang phyug bsod nams skyes/ / de'i tshal sogs kyi ming*/

sna tshogs shing rta de yi tshal | | de yi bu ni gar mkhan mchog /gangs can gnas yin grong khyer ni/ / brgyan pa can yin de'i shing rta/ /me tog rgyas pa can zhes bya/ /mi'am ci dang ci'i skyes bu/ /rta yi gdong can 'gro mgyogs pa/ /gter gyi gtso bo gnyen gter de/ /dbye na dung dang pad+ma sogs/ / nam mkha'i ming*/ lha rtsen rol sa 'khor lo dang*/ /kun 'gegs go 'byed chu sgrogs dang*/ /mi gsal kun 'gro dbus nas gsal/ /bar med mtha' bral lha yi lam/ /mi 'da' rtag sdod khyab 'jug gnas | | kun gsal rnam grol nam mkha'i ming*/ / phyogs spyi'i ming*/ kun khyab gsal gnas nyi mas ston/ /'phrog byed rnams ni phyogs kyi'o/ /shar la sogs pa'i phyogs rnams su/ /dbang po la sogs rim bzhin gnas/ / phyogs kyi glang po'i ming*| rgya mtsho las byung pad+ma dkar/ /g.yon bcings mchod 'gro sa la mos/ /me tog so dang sa steng grags/ /cha mdzes phyogs kyi glang po brgyad/ / glang mo'i ming*/ de dag chung ma sprin grol ma/ /ser skya ma dang dmar ser ma/ /dpe med ma dang zangs rna ma/ /dge ba'i so can yan lag can/ /mchod ldan zhes bya rim pa bzhin | | lcags ri mu khyud khor yug go / sprin gyi ming*/ chu 'dzin sim byed chu khur dang | | chu yi bzhon pa sgra sgrogs dang*/ /rgyun 'dzin brlan 'dzin glog can dang | | sel byed chu yis mgu byed dang*/ /chu 'byin du ba'i skye gnas can/ /ka dam+pa can sprin gyi phreng*/ / 'brug gi ming*/ 'brug sgra sgra sgrogs sprin gyi sgra/ /sgra can dang ni sgra brgya pa/ / glog gi ming*/ sa srung can dang skad cig gsal/ /glog dang rnam gsal g.yo 'gul can/ / thog gi ming*/ 'phro 'joms rdo rje'i zer 'phro ba/ / sprin gyi 'od zer chu las 'bar/ / 'ja' mtshon gyi ming*/ dbang po'i mtshon bya brgya byin gzhu/ /'ja' tshon ming yin de drang na/ /ro hi taṃ zhes bya bar grags/ / char pa'i ming*/

char pa dgung char char rgyun dang*/ /yongs lhung dang ni kun nas 'bab// chu yi zegs ma bad zil can/ /gzhan las sprin gyi bcud dang ni/ /mkha' las babs dang sprin las byung*/ / ser ba'i ming*/ rdo char sdang byed ser ba'i ming*/ / than pa'i ming*/ de la gnod byed than pa sogs/ / yul ngan gyi ming*/ sprin gyis sgrib byed nyi ma ngan/ /mngon par mi gsal nye bar nub/ khebs pa zhes bya yul ngan ming*/ / zla ba'i ming*/ bsil zer can dang sim byed 'od/ /zla ba dbang po ku mod gnyen// byed mkhas bdud rtsi'i 'od can dang*/ /'od dkar can dang rtsi'i dbang phyug /mtshan mo'i bdag po chu las skyes/ /srog 'tsho chags bskyed 'grib pa can/ /ri dwags mtshan pa cha shas gter/ /gnyis skyes rgyal po ri bong 'dzin/ /rgyu skar dbang phyug mtshan mor byed/ /cha shas can dang bcu drug cha/ /'od gzugs dkyil 'khor can phye ba/ /cha nus dum bu yan lag ldan/ /'od ldan kun phan sim 'od can/ /rab gsal rang snub oṃ mtshan dang*/ /rtags can mtshon byed legs zhi ba/ /mchog tu mdzes pa mdzes pa dang*/ /'tsher ldan gsal byed 'gebs pa'o/ khug rna'i ming*/ khug rna lho 'ur ba mo dang*/ /'tsher byed kha ba 'jig las skyes/ /mchod bya khu 'phang bsil yon can/ / rtod phur gyi ming*/ brtan gnas dang ni gan rkyal bu/ / a ga s+t+ya'i ming*/ ri byi dang ni bum pa skyes/ /grogs po dang ni chu lha'i bu/ /mi 'gyur skar ma 'od can dang*/ /sgrol ma can dang mdongs sel ma | | tha skar gyi ming*/ dā k+ṣa'i bu mo rgod ma can/ / rgyal stod kyi ming*/ kun sgrub rnam khyab rgyas byed dang*/ / gro zhun gyi ming*/ grub pa tshim byed legs nyan dang*/ / khrums kyi ming*| nor ldan ba lang khyu mchog rkang*/ / smal po/ ri dwags mgo can ri dwags mag/ོ de nyid lo yi dang po yin/ /steng gi char gnas skar ma dpyid/ /che ba'i bdag po lha'i slob dpon/ /blo ldan bla ma dbyangs bdag po/

/'tsho byed dang ni 'gro ldan bu | | smra ba'i bdag po gtsug phud bkra/ /dum skyes zhes bya phur bu'i ming*/ / pa wa sangs kyi ming*/ khu ba sbyin byed bla ma dang*/ /snyan ngag bu pho mdog mdzes dang*/ / bhṛ gu'i bu dang snyan ngag mkhan/ / mig dmar gyi ming*/ rol 'gro sa skyes sa las byung | | lus dmar dang ni sa yi bu/ /gzhan las bkra shis zhes su grags/ / lhag pa'i ming*/ bra nye'i bu pho rtogs ldan dang*/ /zla ba'i bu ni gza' lhag go / spen pa'i ming*| dal 'gro spen pa'o sgra gcan gyi ming*/ mun can dang*/ /sgra gcan dang ni mtho ris gsal/ /seng ge gcan dang zla ba za/ / khyim gyi ming*/ khyim rnams 'char ba dus sbyor te/ /de ni lug dang glang la sogs/ / nyi ma'i ming*/ ¡Ã snang 'byung chu 'od ( ¡¶ zha ¡· sna tshogs chu byung ) bla med gsal/ /mi sbyin skyes dang bcu gnyis bdag /snang byed nyin byed 'od byed pa/ /rab tu gsal byed rnam gsal byed/ /'od ldan khyab gsal rta bdun pa/ /rta ljang dang ni 'od drod can/ /rnam bsgyur mchod 'os me zlum dang*/ /char 'bebs 'od 'gro gso bar byed/ /nam mkha'i nor bu sgrol byed bshes/ /'od bkra rnam par snang byed dang*/ /gza' yi bdag po 'od nor can | | snang bdag dang ni nyin mo'i bdag /'od gsal gsod byed 'od stong 'phro | | gdung ba 'od 'byin mthus bsgrags so/ /gnas byed dmar ser dbyug pa dang/ /gtum pa'i 'od kyis yongs su bskor/ / kha lo pa'i ming*/ kha lo ba ni 'od dmar dang*/ /brla med ces bya 'od srung dang*/ /mkha' lding zhes bya sdun 'gro ba'o/ / nyi ma'i gur/ yongs su bskor ba yongs 'dzin dang*/ /nye ba'i nyi ma dkyil 'khor can/ / 'od zer gyi ming*/ mun sel ro byed 'jal 'phro snang*/ /phyogs kyi mthar 'gro chu snom dregs/ /gsal ba 'od byed 'od zer can/ / smig rgyu'i ming*/ ri dwags sred dang 'chir 'jug ni/ /smig rgyu'o dus kyi rnam grangs mdor bstan pa/

dus kyi rnam grangs ni/ /bgrang bya dus dang tshod dang ni/ /yang dag 'gro zhes bya bar grags | | tshes sogs rgyas par bshad pa/ tshes gcig phyogs rtsa ( ¡¶ zha ¡· tsam ) rnam grangs yin | | nyin mo'i ming*/ mun gsal nyin mo sdod 'joms dang*/ /mi ldog rtsen dus gnas 'jug dang*/ / snga dro'i ming*/ mi sgrib sad dus nyin mo'i sgo /nam langs zhes bya'o phyi dro'i ming*/ nyin mo'i mtha'/ /nyi bsgyur legs gnas pha skyes dang*/ / thun mtshams kyi ming*/ mel tshe zhes bya thun mtshamasas ming*/ /snga dro phyi dro nyi ma dgung*/ / mtshan mo'i ming*/ thun tshod gsum yin mtshan mo'i ming*/ /bya bral phrar 'jug gnas dus dang*/ /thun gsum pa dang dal ba ster/ /snang ba zlog byed mun pa can/ / rdul can dang ni thun tshod can/ /zhir 'jug snang med mtshan mo che/ /zla dkar rkyang zla snang ba can/ / dkar nag gi phyogs ngos bzung ba/ / tshigs mtshams tshes gcig bco lnga'i bar/ /bco lnga gnyis po phyogs kyi mtha'/ / tshes bco lnga'i ming*/ 'jal byed gang ba'am zla ba nya/ / gnam stong gi ming*/ cha gcig nyams pa rjes 'du zer/ / nyi zla 'dus phyir lhan gnas pa'am/ /'di na gnam stong zhes su grags/ / zla ba mthong ba'i dus/ zla mthong tshes pa'am gzhon nu can/ / ma mthong ba'i dus/ ma mthong chang can ku hur grags/ / nyi ma gzas bzung ba'i ming*/ nyi bsgyur gzas bzung sgra gcan zos | | 'di na spyang gis zin zhes grags/ /nyi zla cig sbyor me tog can/ / dus la sogs pa brtsam tshul/ mig 'dzums bco brgyad mthar gnas la/ /de ni sum cus bgrang ba yin/ /de sum cu la skad cig go /de ni bcu gnyis yud tsam yin/ / de sum cu la nyin zhag gcig /de dag bco lnga phyogs su grags/ /snga phyi'i phyogs ni dkar nag gnyis/ /de gnyis bsdoms pas 'jal byed yin/ / mchu zla| mā ghā la sogs gnyis gnyis la/ /dus tshigs de gsum bgrod pa gcig /lho byang bgrod pa gnyis la lo/ /nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i bi ṣu pa/

/'phel 'grib med pa zhes kyang grags/ / zla ba/ me tog ldan pa'i zla ba nya/ /rgyal gyi zla ba gang yin de/ /ming ni rgyal yin mchu la sogs/ /lhag ma bcu gcig de bzhin no | | ri dwags mgo can mig 'byed dang*/ /lo 'go zhes bya smal po'i ming*/ / rgyal dang tai ṣa mi mjed gsum/ /dka' ( ¡¶ zha ¡· rkang ) thub zla ba mchu gnyis so/ / 'bras bu'i zla ba dka' thub bzang*/ /dbo yin nag pa can nag pa/ /'dod zla sa ga sbrang mgu byed/ /thu bo khu ba dag byed zla/ /mi bzod chu 'dzag mkha' sgra'o// sprin bzang ba lang ba lang rkang*/ khyu mchog rkang pa khrums kyi ming*/ /rgod ma ltad mo'i zla ba dang*/ /rgod ma can ni tha skar ming*/ /smin drug mang ster spro ba can | kha ba 'bab dang grang ba'i dus/ /dgun stod dgun smad rim pa bzhin/ / dpyid dang me tog dus bde byed/ /rdul dus tshad zla nges sreg dus/ /drod phebs drod 'ongs tshad pa can/ /char zla dang ni char pa'i dus/ /'di ni chu yi zla yang zer/ /ston ka gzhan las smin pa'i dus/ /'di ni dpyid zla ra ba sogs// gsum tshan bzhi ru phye ste smra/ /yongs bgrang bgrang gzhi rang skyob dang*/ /'dor byed ces bya lo yi ming*/ /yongs 'joms rab thim rab nub dang*/ /zad pa rab nub mtha' zhes bya/ /bskal pa'i ming yin gzhan du ni/ /'jig dus dus mtha' zad dus zer/ / sdig pa'i ming*/ reg 'phel bsrung bya ngan 'thung dang*/ / dmas byed dge 'dzad rko byed dang*/ /snub byed dang ni bzang po spangs/ / ¡Ã mtshar 'gro dang ni bzang la 'byol/ / ( ¡¶ zha ¡· bsod nams can nyams mi nus pa/ / ) nyes byas rnams ni sdig pa'i ming*/ / dge ba'i ming*/ 'dzin pa yang sbyor rab bsngags dang | | legs byas 'dod 'bab dga' byed tshim/ /rab dga' dga' dang rab mgu byed/ /rangs byed sprod byed kun dga' dang*/ / bsod nams kyi ming*/ sdig srab legs rko bzang dge dang*/ /bsngags 'os zhi byed bzang po dang*/

/phan thob bzang snyegs dge legs dang*/ /skal bzang skal can skal ldan dang*/ /ngan sel bstod 'os mi dge bskyung*/ /bsod nams ming yin bsngags pa yi/ /rnam grangs gzhan ni 'di rjes 'byung*/ / dbang thang gi ming*/ lhas bskos bskos bstan bgo skal dang*/ /skal ba sngon byas rnam grangs te/ /'di ni phyas bskos kha rjer grags | | sa bon gyi ming*/ rgyu dang byed pa khyad 'gro dang*/ /'byung gzhi thog ma'i byed pa po/ /gzhan las nyer len sogs drug bshad/ / bdag gi ming*/ zhing shes bdag dang skyes bu dang*/ / gtso bo la sogs pa'i ming*/ gtso bo rang bzhin khyad par dang*/ / dus 'byung gnas skabs yon tan te/ /gnas pa skye ba thim pas na/ /yon tan gsum yin gzhan du'ang 'dod/ / skye bo'i ming*/ skye ba skye bo skyed byed skye/ /bskrun dang 'byung ba rnam grangs sgra/ /srog ldan shes can skye ldan dang*/ /srog chags skye bo lus can dang*/ /sems can sems pa snying can dang*/ /sgrogs byed 'phrog byed nyal byed nyal/ /

blo gros kyi ming*/ yid 'gro rtsol byed blo shes rab/ /nyal slong blo gros rab mthong dang*/ /nyer dmigs sems pa legs rtogs dang*/ /bsam pa go ba khong du chud/ / rtog dpyod kyi ming*/ kun chub 'dzin blo yang dag rtogs/ / sems kyi longs spyod yid kyi las/ /yid la byed dang dpyod pa dang*/ /bgrang dang rnam par dpyod pa dang*/ /kun nas sdud dang rtogs pa dang*/ / the tshom gyi ming*| mno bsam dang ni som nyi dang*/ /the tshom snyam pa yid gnyis dang*/ / nges pa'i ming*| gtan la phebs dang nges pa dang*/ / log lta'i ming*/ log par lta dang med pa ba | | gnod sems kyi ming*/ 'tshe byed dang ni 'khu ba'i sems/ / grub mtha'i ming*/ grub mtha' dang ni bzung ba'i mtha'/ / blo 'khrul pa'i ming*/ 'khrul pa log blo 'khor ba dang | | dam bca'i ming*/ khas 'che phyogs bzung dam bca' dang*/ /nges byas mnyan byas yongs thos ( ¡¶ zha ¡· thob ) pa/ /bdag gir byas dang khas blangs dang*/ /so sor mnyan dang legs bzung dang*/ /thar pa'i blo gros ye shes so/ / rnam shes kyi ming*| rnam shes bzo yi bstan bcos shes/ / rnam par byang ba'i ming*/ grol ba ma 'dres mya ngan 'das/ /rab bsngags 'chi med nges par legs/ /thar pa dang ni spangs pa'o | | ngar 'dzin gyi ming*/ mi shes ma rig ngar 'dzin blo/ / yul spyi'-i ming*/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya yul/ / dbang po'i ming*/ spyaud yul dbang don bde byed dang*/ /yul can bdag rtag dbang po'i ming*/ /las kyi dbang po kha la sogs/ /blo yi bdag rtag mig la sogs/ / yul so sor las ro'i ming*/ bska ba chu ster mngar ba dang*/ / lan tshwa tsha ba rnon po skyur/ / dri bzang gi ming*/ rnam nyed sbyar spos 'gro yid 'phrog /kun mos dri bzang ring nas 'gugs/ /nges 'phrog legs 'thul sna tshim byed// 'dod dri dri zhim ngad bzang ste/ / dri ngan gyi ming*/ rul dri dri ngan dri btsog sogs/ / dkar po'i ming*/

dkar po dkar gsal 'od gsal dang*/ /mdog dkar gzhan gcod dkar snum dang*/ /skya bseng dag mdog yid sdebs dang*/ /mdog bsngags mig stobs dkar dag dang*/ / ngang mdog gi ming*/ srid sgrub skya bo ri dwags mdong | | ngang pa'o nag po'i ming*/ nag po sngon po dang*/ /dkar min sngo bsangs mdog nag dang*/ /rnying ma'i mdog go ser po'i ming*/ ser po dang*/ /mdog bsngags dang ni yung ba'i mdog / ljang gu'i ming*/ ljang gu ljang ser lo ma'i mdog / 'di na bsrubs kha'o dmar po'i ming*/ dmar po dang*/ /mdog dmar dmar dang khrag mdog dang*/ / leb rgan gyi ming*/ ka na da mdog mi gsal na/ /skya rengs dmar skya pā ṭa la/ / dud ka'i ming*/ du mdog dud ka dmar nag la'o/ / ser skya'i ming*/ ser skya dkar ser ser bseng dang*/ /dmar ser rkyang zer 'di na ni/ /skyer kha zhes grags bkra ba dang*/ / sna tshogs kyi ming*/ sna tshogs bgrang snang 'dres ma dang*/ khra bo zhes bsgrags rnam grangs sgra/ / sgra spyi'i ming*/ tshangs byung gso bsgrags brjod pa dang | | dbyangs dang sgra dang sgra can dang*/ /mtsho byung rnam brjod gleng ba dang*/ / smra dang 'chad dang bshad dang lab/ /zur chag dang ni sgra nyams pa/ / lung du ston pa'i sgra'i ming*/ brjod byed bstan bcos sgra la ni/ /te nga sub kyi mtha' can ngag / byed pa'am bya ba dang ldan pa/ / rig byed kyi ming*/ thos pa rig byaid gsum man ngag/ gsum pa'i chos ni de'i cho ga /snyan ngag nges brjod mchod sbyin gsum/ /'di gsum rig byed gsum po yin/ /bslab sogs thos pa'i yan lag go / 'don pa la 'jug tshul/ oṃ gyi yi ge phyag 'tshal ba/ /i ti hāsaḥpū rā bṛt+ta dang*/ /ut+ta ta la sogs gsum dbyangs/ / lung gi rjes su rtog cing 'byed pa/ ā n+wī k+ṣi kī daṇ+ḍa'i lugs/ / rtog ge'i ming*/ rtog ge rig pa don bstan bcos/ / bstan bcos spyi'i ming*/ ā khya ¡Ã yi ko ( ¡¶ zha ¡· ika u

) pa lab+dha/ /pū ra ṇa ni mtshan nyid lnga/ / 'jig rten gtam rgyud kyi ming*/ rtog pas rab tu bcings pa'i gtam/ / ¡Ã pra ban+dhi kā pra he li kā/ / ( ¡¶ zha ¡· pra dha hi pra dhe li kā / ) bsdus pa'i ming*/ dran pas chos yang dag par bsdus/ /legs bsdus pa dang bsdus pa'o/ /tshig bsdu ba dang bsdus pa'i don// gtam smra ba'i ming*/skye bos thos pa ci rung brjod/ /bār+t+ta pra bṛt+tī pra b-it+tān+tā/ /u dan+ta s+t+yā da ā khyā/ /ā he a bhi ngha na dang*/ /ming brjod pa dang ming dang ni/ /hūm̐ tiḥ.ā kā ra ṇā hā ( ¡¶ zha ¡· dha ) ṇa | | saṃ hū hi ni mang pos byas/ / rtsod pa'i ming*/ rtsod pa dang ni tha snyad dang*/ / bsnyon 'debs pa'i ming*/ nye bar dgod pa smra ba'i sgo/ /u pod+ghā ta u dā hā ra/ / mna'i ming*| mna' dang bros 'don 'dir dbu bsnyung*/ / 'dri ba'i ming*/ 'dri ba shes 'dod rjes su sbyor/ / lan gyi ming*/ lan dang slar brjod rjes ston pa/ / rdzun tshig gi ming*/ log pa'i sbyor ba ngan brjod dang*/ / skur 'debs kyi ming*/ log par bsngags pa mngon par smod/ / bsngags pa'i ming*/ legs pa ston sgra rjes chags skyes/ / snyan bsgrags kyi ming*/ mchod tshig legs sgrog yang dag shes/ / bstod pa'i ming*/ bstod pa bstod sgra bstod tshig bstod/ /skyor tshig gnyis gsum brjod pa'o/ / ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + legs pa ston pa rjes chags skye/ / ) sgra gsang mthon po dbyangs yin no/ /gcong skad mo yi rnam 'gyur te | | mya ngan sogs las byung ba'i sgra/ / smod pa'i ming*/ mi bsngags bsdigs tshig nges par rgol/ /yongs smod sun 'byin khro tshig dang*/ /gshe dang brgyad ( ¡¶ zha ¡· rgod ) dang smod pa dang*/ /tshig rtsub rgol ba sma 'bebs tshig /chags pa'i khro ba 'khrig pa'i gzhi/ /kun brjod dang ni yongs sgra ( ¡¶ zha ¡· smra ) dang*/ /lab lob dang ni don med gtam/ / tshig zlos pa'i ming*/ rjes su smra dang yang yang smra/ / tshig 'gal ba'i ming*|

rnam smra dang ni yongs gdung tshig /cal col dang ni 'gal ba'i tshig/ sgra mi gsal ba'i ming*/ dab dib dang ni grong gtam dang*/ / legs par brjod pa'i ming*/ legs par smra dang legs bshad dang*/ /gsang sgra gsong gtam nyid yin no/ / phan tshig gi ming*/ phan byed smra ba 'phyon ma'i tshig /dge gtam 'jam gtam 'phrod gtam dang*/ / tshig rtsub kyi ming*/ snying la 'bab pa gdung tshig dang*/ /tshig rtsub grong pa tshig mi legs/ / dga' ba bskyed pa'i tshig gi ming*/ gtam snyan dga' byed bden pa dang | | blun tshig gi ming*/ glen tshig bsnyon rmongs phan tshun 'gal/ /mi gsal ma rdzogs brjod nyams dang*/ / mchil tshig gi ming*/ myur brjod chu tshig mchil ma can// 'brel med tshig gi ming*/ ma 'brel don med yi ge bral/ /brjod bya med pa gsog dang rdzun | | bden tshig gi ming*/ mi gsal mi bden de nyid dang*/ /yid 'byung de bzhin yid 'bab dang*/ /yang dag bden pa'o gzhan las ni/ /mi slu ba la sogs pa'ang grags/ / lung du mi ston pa'i sgra rnams kyi ming*/ sgra dang nges sgrogs grag pa dang*/ / sgrogs pa ca co ku co dang*/ /lhang tser ding 'ur shu sgra sogs/ /shod sgra ( ¡¶ zha ¡· dang ) gos sgra lo ma yi/ khral khrol zhes bya rgyan gyi sgra/ /kwa ṇaḥkwa ṇaḥl sogs dang | | sngon du ni dang pra byin pa/ /dri za sogs kyi pi wang sgra/ /ca co dar dir la sogs pa/ /mang po mi gsal ba yi sgra/ /'bu sgra la sogs dud 'gro'i sgra/ / sgra brnyan lan sgra 'dir brag ca/ /glu dang dbyangs mtshungs 'dren pa la/ /'dres dang khyu mchog gan+dha ra/ /drug skyes bar ma blo gsal ba/ /lnga pa zhes bya'i dkyus bdun pa'o/ /pi wang dang ni mgul pa'i sgra/ /sgra cha phra ba kā ka li/ /mi gsal snyan pa dhā ni yin/ /zab mo sgra ni man+t+ra ste/ /shin tu mthon po tā ra'o/ /'a ( ¡¶ zha ¡· la ) ya thams cad mnyam pa yin/ /pheg rdob rnar 'jug balka li/ /rnam spros dang ni rgyud can no/

/rgyud bdun pa ri bā di nī/ / pi wang sogs sgra ta taṃ yin | | ā nad+dha dang murdza sogs/ /gling bu sogs la bu ga can/ /'khar rnga pheg rdob sogs sil snyan/ /rnam pa 'di bzhi rol mo'i sgra/ /mṛ taṃ ga dang murdza dang*// de yi bye brag aṃ kyā dang*/ /a liṅga dang ur+dha ka'o/ /ya shaḥpa ḍa haḥṭa k+ka/ /bhe ri ā na ka dang ni/ /dun+du bhi dang ā na ka /pa ḍa haḥdang ko na dang*/ /pi wang khog pa pra bā la/ /de yi rtse mo ka ku bha/ /rab bsdams pa zhes bya bar grags// 'phangs 'gro'o rtsa bar ldems pa'i shing*/ /u pa na ho zhes bya'o/ /rol mo'i bye brag du ( ¡¶ zha ¡· ḍā ) ma ru/ /mad du ḍiṇ+ḍi dzha dza ra/ /marda la dang pa ṇa ba/ /gar mkhan dang ni rol mo ba/ /dal dang myur dang bar ma la/ /ta twa o go ga ṇaṃ zer | | de sogs gar gyi skabs don 'ga'/ /bod la mkho ba chung phyir bzhag/ nyams kyi ming mdor bstan pa/ sgeg pa dpa' ba snying rje dang*/ /ngam pa rgod dang 'jigs su rung*/ /mi sdug drag shul nyams brgyad do/ / rgyas par bshad pa/ sgeg pa gtsang ba rab 'bar ba/ /spro ba bskyed dang dpa' ba yin/ /snying rje bde 'gog bdag dbang byed/ /thugs rje gtong dang rjes su brtse/ /rjes su khro bo rgod pa dang | | bzhad pa rgod bag gad mo 'byin/ /mi sdug pa yi rnam par 'gyur/ /ngo mtshar rmad byung mtshar che ba/ /sna tshogs zhes bya'o 'jigs rung dang*/ /'dar 'jug dang ni 'jigs byed dang*/ /nyam nga can dang 'jigs pa dang*/ /'jigs sde 'jigs pa 'jigs par byed/ /skrag byed so sor 'jigs drag po/ /drag shul zhes bya 'di dag nyams/ /'jigs skrag la sogs thun mong ba/ / nyams kyi khyad par ming*/ yid kyi rnam 'gyur ngo bo dang*/ /nyams dang rjes myong go byed do/ / nga rgyal gyi ming*/ snyems pa mngon pa'i nga rgyal dang*/ /ngar byed nga rgyal yid mtho ba'o// ma gus pa'i ming*/ ma dad zil gnon yongs su smod/ /zhum byed mtshang dgod mchod mi byed/

/shes par mi byed ma brtsis pa/ /mi mos pa'o 'di na ni/ /mtshang 'dru rgol dang bshung pa dang*/ /brgyad bkag la sogs gzhan yang grags/ / ngo tsha ba'i ming*| mig dman ngo tsha ngo mi 'dzem/ /zhum zhing pa gong 'khums pa'ang zer/ / bzod pa'i ming*/ bzod pa gtong 'os mngon snyems dang*/ / phrag dog gi ming*/ mi bzod phrag dog skyon sgro 'dogs/ / khon 'dzin gyi ming*/ dpal bskyed 'gal ba rnam par 'gog | mya ngan gyi ming*/ sems sdug mya ngan gdung ba'o/ / 'gyod pa'i ming*/ phyis nas gdung ba rjes gdung dang*/ /rnam par snyil ba 'gyod pa'o/ / khro ba'i ming*/ khro ba 'khrug pa ma rungs pa/ /mi mnogs gzhan bsnun sems 'khrug pa/ / tshul khrims ming*| gtsang bar spyod pa tshul khrims so/ / 'khrul sems la/ smyo sems rnam par 'khrul ba'o/ / dga' ba'i ming*/ nyams dga' dga' nyid snying yang dga'/ /sems snum 'di ni dgyes pa sogs/ / 'dod pa'i ming*/ 'dod pa re ba 'dod spro dang*/ / thob 'dod sred pa chags rnyed 'dod/ /yid kyi shing rta 'dod chags dang*/ / mngon 'dod zhen pa de che na/ /rngams che 'di na zhe nyer grags/ / don sems pa'i ming*| nyer 'dzin chos sems kun 'dzin yid/ /yid gdung gcags pa shin tu sems | | spro ba zhan pa'o brtson 'grus kyi ming*/ brtson ldan yid/ / g.yo sgyu'i ming*/ de tshe rdul ldan phod tshangs 'gro/ /snyad ka rang mthong snyad 'dogs dang*/ /'gebs dang khram dang ngan kyog dang*/ /ngan byed g.yo can bag med dang*/ /yid mi rton yin 'di na ni/ /lhod la sogs pa'ang cha mthun yin/ / bzhad gad kyi ming*/ mtshar 'dod dag 'dod skyo bsangs dang*/ /sdig sel 'di ni ku rer grags/ / bud med kyi sgeg pa'i ming*/ bud med rnams kyi rtse ba la/ /rol pa dang ni stegs 'gros dang*// rnam skor sgeg 'gros nyams dga' sogs/ /hā bāḥzhes grags bya ba rnams/ / sgeg pa las byung nyams su bshad/ / rtsed mo'i ming*/

'dzag dang rtse dang gad mo dang*// rol rtsed 'jo sgeg g.yer bag dang/ /snyad ka 'khyog tshig mtshon pa dang*/ /byis rtsed rtse ba rtsed mo'o/ / rngul gyi ming*/ lus chu rngul dang lus kyi rngul/ / dran pa med pa'i ming*| sems stor snya ( ¡¶ zha ¡· smra ) dang sems nyams dang*/ /hon stong pa dang rnam 'gyur sbed/ /'ur dang shin tu 'bros pa'o/ / gad mo'i ming*/ ga chad kun nas dga' dang dgod/ /chung ngu 'dzum pa'o bar ma ni/ /gad mo'i spu sdang ba spu langs/ / ngu ba'i ming*/ ngu 'bod cho nge mchi ma 'dzag / g.yal ba'i ming*/ glal dang g.yal ba'o bslu ba'i ming*| bslu ba dang*/ /'drid tshig ngag 'bras gzhan pa dang*/ /yid brtan med pa'o nyal ba'i ming*/ gnyid dang ni/ /nyal dang gzims dang rmi lam dang*/ /legs phab snya dang glo phab pa/ / khros pa'i 'gyur ba la/ smin bsdus khro gnyer smin mtshams bsdus | | dga' ston gyi ming*/ dga' ston mchod chen lha gsol lo/ /mtho ris kyi sde'o || || sa 'og gi ming*/ 'og ma sa 'og rkang 'og dang*/ /stobs ldan gnas dang bcud 'og dang*/ /klu yi 'jig rten bu ga 'tsher/ khung bu'i ming*/ khung dang bu ga khung bu dang | | bu gu bug pa dmigs khung dang*/ /gsal mthong mkha' mthong rlung 'byung rnams/ /thun mong ming yin sa khung dang*/ /sa phug dong sgo dong bug sgo / mun pa'i ming*/ sdongs byed mun pa zhi ldan dang*/ /rab rib nyer nub mun nag smag /mthug na she mun srab na ni/ /nam mkha' dag pa zhes bya'o/ /kun khyab mun khyab bgrod med mun/ / klu'i rgyal po'i ming*/ ka dru'i bu dang lhag ma dang*/ /mtha' yas nor rgyas sbrul can dang*/ / sbrul bye brag gi ming*/ ba lang sna dang thig le'i lus/ /a dza ga nyal rlung gis dga'/ /chu sbrul dang ni myur 'gro 'dod/ /thig le dkar ldan rnga bo che/ /kla klo gso dang kla klo'i sbrul/ / shun pa brje ba'i ming*/ shun pa brjes pa go cha grol | | sbrul spyi'i ming*/

sa la reg 'gro sa la 'phye/ /'khyog 'gro gya gyu 'khyug 'gro 'phye | | mche ba dug can dug 'dzin dang*/ /'gros kyog rnam 'dzin 'khor lo can | | 'khyil ba rkang sbas mig gis thos/ /lto 'phye gdengs can gzar bu mag ོ | rgyab rings zas ngan khung du nyal/ /brang mgro rkang gis mi 'gro dang*/ / rmugs 'gro dang ni 'phel ga can/ /rlung za'o sbrul las byung ba ni/ /dug dang rus pa la sogs so/ / gdengs ka'i ming*/ s+phu ṭa yān dang pha ṇa gnyis/ /kañtsu ka dang ni rmo ka / sbrul dug gi ming*/ k+ṣe ḍa ga ra laṃ gyi dug /kā ko la dang kā la kūṭa/ /ha la ha lā sā roṣ+ti ka /solki ka dang tshangs pa'i bu/ /pra dī pa naḥdā ra da/ /be'u'i lte ba zhes bya ba/ /dug gi dbye ba rnam dgu'o/ / dug gi sman pa'i ming*/ dug gi sman pa dug sel dang*/ / sbrul 'dzin pa'i ming*/ sbrul 'dzin dang ni tuṇ+ḍi ka / dmyal ba'i ming*/ dmyal ba dang ni ngan 'gro'i mthil/ /'dod 'bras bral dang ngan 'gro'o/ /de yi dbye ba tsha ba sogs/ /

yi dwags kyi ming*/ yi dwags grub med 'tsho dpal min/ / de'i sdug bsngal gyi ming*/ 'gro bral ngan khyab bla med dang*/ /brnag dka' ngan myong ¡Ã tsher ma ( ¡¶ zha ¡· 'tsho ba ) rtsub/ /na ba bro nad sdug bsngal dang*/ /yid 'grogs dang ni skye las skyes/ /dka' dang gcod sbyor 'jigs pa len/ / rgya mtsho'i ming*/ zla bas 'phel dang chu 'dzin dang*/ /pha rol mi mngon pha rol sgrib/ /chu klung bdag po chu ldan dang*/ /chu srel dang ni 'bab ldan dang*/ /chu can dug can chu rgyan can// rin chen 'byung gnas chu gter dang*/ /chu srin bdag po chu yi bdag / de'i bye brag gi ming*/ de yi bye brag 'o chu dang*/ /tshwa chu ba tshwa'i chu dang ni/ /zho chu dang ni chu yi chu/ / mar gyi chu dang bur shing chu/ /chang gi chu dang zhim chu'o/ chu la/ khyab pa mnyam sgrib thur du 'gro/ /'dod bya 'bru phan 'gog byed dang*/ /'ching byed mi 'chi 'tsho ba dang | | 'byung byed rten pa lus 'ching dang*/ /'dzag pa gso byed rgyas byed dang | | kun phyogs snyun byed btang 'gro dang*/ /rdzi bo btung bya 'og 'gro dang*// zad byed ltung byed bde mchog dang*/ /sprin gyi me tog sprin gyi bcud/ / chu rlabs kyi ming*| dba' dang dba' rlabs mthor 'gro dang*/ /mtshar g.yo khrem gnyer bgre ldog dang*/ /chil sgrog ces bya rlabs kyi ming*/ / chu 'khor dang zegs ma'i ming*/ klong dang chu yi 'khor lo dang*/ /chu 'thor thigs pa chu phru dang*/ /chu yi zegs ma'o chu rgyun gyi ming*/ rgyun 'khyog dang/ /sbyor 'byed dang ni rgyug chu'o/ /'di na klung dang chu klung dang*/ /'bab chu chu rgyun gtsang po'o/ / chu ngogs kyi ming*/ 'gram dang 'gog byed ngogs dang ni/ /chu ngogs dang ni chu kha dang*/ /pha rol tshu rol phan tshun ngogs/ / chu srol gyi ming*/ de gnyis bar ni lhung skyob yin/ /'di na chu srol zhes su grags/ / gling gi ming*/ gnyis 'gram dbus skam chu dbus dang*/

/chu yi sgang yin 'di na gling | | tshal zhes la lar grags pa yod/ / 'dam rdzab kyi ming*/ byings pa rdzab dang 'dam bag dang*/ /'dam rdzab dang ni 'jim pa'o/ / gru'i ming*/ bskul 'gro sgrol byed sgrol ba dang*/ /rtsa gzings 'phyos 'gro gru yi ming*/ / 'bab chu'i ming*/ rgyun dang 'bab chu chu klung klung*/ / gru btsas kyi ming*/ gru gla sgrol rngan 'dir mnyan gla/ / chu gzar gyi ming*/ shing gis chu 'chu chu gzar yin/ / gru nang gi skyes bu'i ming*/ gzings bdag gru yi tshong pa dang*/ /rna ba 'dzin pa gru pa dang*/ /gzhan las gdos pa 'dzin pa dang | | 'di na mnyan pa skya ba 'dzin/ / ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· + gzhan la ltos cing stobs pa dang*// sel ba chu skya 'dzin zhes zer/ / ) gzings kyi bdag po gru la zhon/ / gru nang btsugs pa'i shing gi ming*/ 'dren shing gru thag 'dogs sa'i shing*/ / gru skya'i ming*/ gru skul dbyu gu gdos pa yin/ /chu la 'dzugs pa skya ba'o/ /shing tog shing gi tog rtse yin/ / chu 'thor snod kyi ming*/ 'thor snod chu mthor zhes bya'o/ / chu dwangs rnyog gi ming*/ dwangs pa chu gtsang snyigs ma can/ /rnyog chu dang ni chu snyigs so/ / chu gting ring thung gi ming*/ gzhol ba zab pa zab mo ste/ /de las bzlog pa gsal le ba/ /'og gzhi mi reg rab med do/ / nya pa'i ming*/ chu gnas nya pa dol thogs kyang*/ / nya rgya'i ming*/ 'chu ba dra ba'o sha na yi/ /srad bu pa pi tra ka zer/ /smyug ma'i dra ba nya 'dzin no/ / lcags kyu'i ming*/ nya 'bigs 'chil pa zhes su grags/ / nya spyi'i ming*/ spu rings nya dang spro ba can/ / 'gro ldan dang ni sna tshogs rgyu/ /sgong skyes rnam 'phyo byang bu can/ /sha ku lār+bha ga ṭa kaḥ nya'i bye brag gi ming*/ mche ba stong ldan rgyab mtho dang*/ /steng 'gro dang ni shi shu kaḥ tsi li tsi ma 'dam bu'i nya/ / nya gzhon nu la/ proṣ+ṭhi dang ni sha pa rī/ /sgo nga phra mo'i nya tshogs la/ /tshang ma'o de bzhin ri ṣaḥdang*/

/ro hi ta dang maṅku raḥ shā la dang ni rā dzī ba/ /sha ku la dang ti miḥdang*/ / chu srin sogs sraug chags kyi ming*/ nya mid la sogs chu srin ni/ /nya yi rigs gtogs de'i bye brag /byis pa gsod dang shaṅka ba | | ma ka rā la sogs pa rnams/ /ku li ra dang karka ṭa'o/ /shugs ngan dang ni ka ma thra/ /'gram skyong dang ni grī'i ha dang*/ /spa skong 'di na rus sbal zer/ /na kra dang ni kum+bhi ra'o/ /sa yi 'khri shing srog chags dang*/ /da byid skyin gor rnam grangs yin/ khrag 'thung dang ni dza lau kaḥ chu shig pa yin 'dir pad pa/ / 'ga' zhig srog chags pad+ma zer/ /mu tig s+pho ṭaḥrnam grangs yin/ /mu tig skyed la 'dir nya phyis/ /nya skyogs kyang de dung dang ni/ /kam+pu ra dang dung phran no/ /chu yi nya phyis nya skyogs so/ /sbal pa dbyar skyes 'phar 'gro dang*/ /dardu ra'o rus sbal mo/ /du liḥzhes bya maṅku ra'o/ /chung ma rwa can ma zhes grags/ 'khy-il chu'i ming*| khron pa rab 'dren chus skyob dang*/ / rdzing bu'i ming*/ mu khyud can yin rdzing bu dang | | yongs bskos dang ni lhas bskos pa'o/ / mtsho phran sogs kyi ming*/ pad+ma'i 'byung gnas sgra ldan dang*/ /chu gnas 'bab pa mtsho yin te/ /chu ngan mtshe'u rdzing bu dang*/ /rdzing rings rdzing gi bye brag yin/ / chu spyi'i ming*/ sgra ldan 'gyus 'gro dba' rlabs can/ /zi ma can dang chu ngogs can/ /klung can dang ni g.yo ba can | | rgyun can dang ni gling can ma/ /'dzag ldan gzhol 'gro mtshor 'bab bo | | gaṅgā'i ming*/ gaṅgā dang ni khyab 'jug rkang*/ /dza h+nu'i bu mo lha yi chu/ /skal ldan shing rta lam gsum 'bab/ /rgyun gsum pa dang 'jigs pa'i ma/ / ya mu nā'i ming | rtsod ldan nyi ma'i bu mo dang*/ /zhi ba'i sring mo ya mu nā/ / sin+dhu la/ re wā ta dang narma dwa/ /zlas byung de cha'i bu mo dang*/ /lag chu dang ni rtag pa'i chu/ / si tā'i ming*/ dpung pas byin dang dkar po 'bab/ /si tā druḥdang brgyar gyes dang*/

/zhags pa grol dang bi pāṣ+tu/ / chu bo gzhan gyi ming*/ dmar skya dang ni gser dngul lo/ /'dam bu can dang dba' can dang*/ /zla ba'i cha dang dbyangs can ma/ /kā be rā dang sa ri ta/ /gzhan yang bye brag du ma yod/ /chu bo 'dres pa chu bo 'dus/ /chu yi lam ni wa ti'o/ / me tog gi dri'i ming*/ dri bzang chu 'phrog yid tshim dang*/ / ut+pal spyi la/ mtshams dmar de bzhin steng du 'thung*/ /ku ba la gnyis ut+pal ming*/ / de'i bye brag sogs kyi ming*/ sngo na in+d+ri bā ra ste/ /dkar na sa sgrogs sa mos so/ /de yi sdong bu sha lu ka/ chu yi lo ma bum pa can/ /chu yi sngo ni she be la/ /chur nyal 'di ni zi ma zer/ /ku mud mang po yid mos tshal/ / pad+ma spyi bye brag sogs kyi ming*/ pad+ma mang po na li ni/ /pad can pad tshal pad+ma'i tshogs/ /rkang 'gros bcings bzang rtsibs rnyed dang*/ /ut+pal chen po 'dab stong pa/ /chu rgyan 'dab brgya chur nyal dang | | chu skyes chur gnas mtshor skyes dang*/ /ze 'bru'i phreng ldan sdong bu skyes// chab 'khrungs dang ni puṣ+ka ra/ /puṇ+ḍa rī ka pad+ma dkar/ /dmar na mtsho skyes ut+pa la | | dmar po ko ka na da zer/ / sdong bu'i ming*/ sdong bu dang ni chu ba dang*/ /rkang bu dang ni ngar pa sogs/ /me tog rnams kyi rtsa ba yin/ / lte ba la/ snying po shi phā kan+daḥni/ / ge sar gyi ming*/ dbus yin ze 'bru skra rdul dang*/ /ze ba ge sar rnam grangs so/ / 'dab ma'i ming*/ legs par 'phel ba 'dab ma gsar/ /lte ba sa bon mdzod yin no/ /sa 'og gi sde'o// //mtho ris mkha' dang phyogs dus blau/ /sgra sogs gar dang bcas pa dang*/ /sa 'og gdengs can dmyal ba chu/ /de dag dang ni 'brel bcas bshad | | 'chi med mdzod las bshad bzhin 'dir dgos rnams/ /sgra don ji bzhin bsgyur nas ngas 'di bshad/ /da dung legs cha du ma yod mod kyi/ /phal cher nyung la dga' phyir re zhig bzhag /grags dang ma grags brda dang brda min dang*/

/sgra 'gyur legs nyes bsgyur dang ma bsgyur dang*/ khams dang nyer sgyur 'chad lugs tha dad dang*/ /mi 'dra'i dbye ba gzhan du ngas bshad mod | | gzhung bshad pa dang snyan ngag sbyor 'dod rnams/ /legs par sbyar ba'i skad kyi rjes 'jug pa'i/ /tshig gi gter 'di zungs la gang dgos sbyor/ /lhar bcas 'jig rten dga' ba'i tshig yin no/ /dge ba 'di yis bdag dang sems can rnams/ /shes bya'i dkyil 'khor kun la rab yangs blos/ /dpal 'byor dge legs kun gyi gnas bsgrubs te/ /thams cad gzigs pa'i go 'phang myur thob shog /tshig gi gter zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos 'di ni yongs su grags pa'i shes bya'i gnas phal mo che blau yul du byas pa/ sgra dang*/ tshad ma dang*/ sdeb sbyor dang*/ tshig gi rgyan dang*/ snyan ngag dang*/ ming gi mngon brjod ¡Ã dang*/ rtsis dang*/ sman dpyad dang*/ bzo'i gnas ( ¡¶ zha ¡· - dang*/ rtsis bzo'i gnas ) la sogs pa mkhas pa rnams 'jug pa'i yan lag thams cad la sbyangs shing*/ lung dang rigs pa'i de kho na nyid phyin ci ma log par khong du chud pa/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos | dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du legs par sbyar ba re zhig rdzogs so// // ༄༅/ /sdeb sbyor sna tshogs me tog gi chun po zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /sdeb sbyor sna tshogs me tog gi chun po zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde gshegs dbang po khyod kyi gsung zer tsha zer byed pa'i 'od zer 'phros pas rgya mtsho'i gos can 'di na log lta yi/ /tshang tshing brgyas gzings ston par khas 'che che bar mngon rlom sna tshogs 'byin byed sbrang rtsi'i dgra dang lus med rtsen// dpal mgrin mig stong lha yi bla ma gos med pas khrid gang gi gzhung lugs nyin mo long ba ltar mdzad pa/ /blau gter dbang pos blau yi kha 'byed rgyal ba nyin mor byed pa'i gsung 'od rab gsal rgyun du bdag gi spyi bor len/

/gang gis srid dang rnam grol rnam gsum gyi/ /the tshom drwa ba kun nas 'grol mdzad pa | | dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad skyed pa'i yum/ /'jam mgon bla ma'i zhabs la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /gangs ri'i khrod 'dir sngon chad mkhas rnams kyi | | rna ba'i snod du nye bar ma lhung zhing*/ /lce yi dbang pos kun nas ma myangs pa | | ro brgya'i 'byung gnas dpag bsam shing 'di bskyed/ /gzhung rtsom byed pa rnams kyang rmongs gyur na/ /de las gzhan pa smos kyang ci dgos pa/ /de 'dra'i don la kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal/ /bzang po blau gros 'jigs med de yis phye/ /rang gis brjod pa bde zhing*/ gzhan gyis rtogs par sla la/ gnyis ka'i rnar snyan pa zhig sdeb sbyor gyi gtsug lag shes na 'byung bas/ de mi mkhas pa rnams la bstan pa'i phyir 'di brtsam mo/ /tshigs su bcad dang rkyang pa dang*/ /rgyun chags zhes bya rnam pa gsum/ /tshig gi sbyor ba byed 'dod pa'i// mkhas pa rnams kyi 'jug ngogs yin/ /'dir mkhas pa rnams bstan bcos rtsom pa la 'jug pa na/ brjod bya'i don ji snyed pa rnams tshigs su bcad pa dang | tshig lhug pa dang*/ rgyun chags pa zhes bya ba rnam pa gsum gyis ston la/ rgyun chags pa de'ang gnyis te/ rgyun chags bcad pa dang*/ ma bcad pa'o/ /de la rgyun chags bcad pa ni/ 'dir tshigs su bcad pa'i bye brag yin pas tshigs su bcad pa nyid kyi nang du bshad par bya'o/ /rgyun chags ma bcad pa ni/ sdeb sbyor gyi mtshan nyid lci yang la sogs pas phye la/ bya ba ston pa'i sgra yod pa/ rkang pa bzhir ma bcad pa ste/ de skad du yang sdeb sbyor gyi tshoms las/ rkang pa dag gis ma bcad pa/ /gang la yi ge sbrel legs yod/ /bya ba'i tshig gis gsal byas pa/ /de ni rgyun chags las gzhan min/ /zhes 'don pa'i phyir ro// 'di'i dper brjod pa ni kho bo'i bla ma chos kyi rje dpal sa skya pa rgyal mtshan gyi mthas brgyan pa'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa'i bstod pa 'ga' zhig las 'byung ba lta bu'o/

/'di lta bu'i sdeb sbyor ni/ deng sang rgya gar na sdeb sbyor ba ches che ba mang du thos pa 'ga' zhig la grags pa tsam du zad kyi/ thams cad la grags pa ma yin la/ sbyor ba yang ches shin tu nyung bar snang ngo*/ /tshig lhug pa'i sbrel lugs ji ltar yin pa yang*/ kho bos mkhas pa rnams 'jug pa'i sgor bshad zin la/ 'dir skabs ma yin pa'i phyir rnam par dbye ba ma byas so/ /da ni skabs su bab pa tshigs su bcad pa'i sdeb sbyor la 'jug par 'dod pas/ 'dir ni tshig dbang sbyor rnams kyi/ /tshigs su bcad pa gsal bar bya/ / skabs 'dir ni tshig gi dbang po ste/ sdeb sbyor mkhan rnams kyis legs par sbyor ba/ tshogs par dbyung bar bya ba'i ngag gang gis sbyor shes na mkhas pa rnams kyi kha rgyan du 'gyur ba/ gya nom pa sbyor nus na rgyal po'i grwar rnyed pa dang bkur sti'i gter thob pa/ don dang tshig la sngon ma byung ba'i rgyan bsam pa dag pas sbyar na/ yi dam gyi lhas mngon sum du zhal ston pa/ phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug par mkhas pa rnams kyis snyan pa'i ba dan sgrogs par 'gyur ba'i gzhi sdeb sbyor gyi mtshan nyid bshad par bya'o/ /dmar ser dang ni rgyal ba'i lhas/ / mdo dang de yi dpe brjod byas/ /thog mar drang song dmar ser zhes bya bas sdeb sbyor gyi mdo sbyar la/ de'i 'og tu rgyal ba'i lha zhes bya bas tshigs su bcad pa rnams kyi dpe brjod pa sbyar ro/ /de dag gi rjes su gzhan dang gzhan rnams kyis kyang tha dad pa du ma 'bad nas sbyar mod kyi/ 'on kyang de dag gi dgod bya'i rim pa la mur thug pa med pa dang*/ lci yang gi ming la sogs pa tshigs su bcad pas ma bcings pa dang*/ phal cher mi gsal ba dang*/ gsal ba'i sbyor ba rnams kyang sngon med pa ma byas pa dang*/ ngal bso ba dang*/ lus dang ming rnams kyi 'dres pa yang ma phyed pa dang*/ de nyid kyis 'don pa na gdong pham par 'gyur ba dang*/

ngal so ba dang*/ yi ge dag mi mnyam par gcod pas na/ go rim rigs pa med pa dang*/ tshigs su bcad pa 'ga' zhig 'don pa mi bde bas | de dag sun phyung nas bde blag tu bstan pa'i phyir/ rin chen 'byung gnas zhi ba yis/ /sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas mdzad/ /dus phyis rtsod pa'i dus kyi thams cad mkhyen par grags pa slob dpon rin chen 'byung gnas zhi bas sdeb sbyor gyi bstan bcos rin chen 'byung gnas zhes bya ba yon tan brgyad kyis khyad par can du 'phags pa mdzad de/ de skad du yang*/ bsdus dang tshigs bcad rang bzhin gsal/ /mdo la dper brjod byas pa dang*/ /ma 'dris rim 'don tha ma ru/ /ngal bso'i yi ge yon tan yin/ /zhes bshad pas so | | de lta bu'i tshigs su bcad pa de la dbye na/ 'phel dang bskyed pa'i dbye ba yis/ /tshigs su bcad pa rnam pa gnyis/ /'phel ba yi ge bgrang ba ste/ / bskyed pa dag ni phyi mor bzhed/ /tshig ldan dang*/ rkang pa can dang*/ rkang pa bzhi pa dang*/ tshigs su bcad pa zhes bya ba ni rnam grangs so/ /tshigs su bcad pa de yang sdeb sbyor gyis dbye na gnyis te/ rgyud 'phel dang*/ bskyed pa'o/ /de yang yi ge bgrang ba ni/ rgyud 'phel zhes bya ba la/ phyi mo bgrang ba ni/ bskyed pa zhes bya'o/ /de dag gi gzhi dgod pa yang 'di ltar shes par bya ste/ dbyangs kyi yi ge nyi shu gnyis/ /gsal byed sum cu rtsa bdun yin/ /yi ge 'ba' zhig brjod pa gsal ba de ni dbyangs zhes bya'o/ /de'ang bsdu na gsum ste/ thung ngu dang

| ring po dang*/ shin tu ring po'o/ /gcig gi tshad ni thung ngu yin la/ de ni rnam pa lnga ste/ a i u ṛ l̥'o/ /gnyis kyi tshad ni ring po yin la/ de ni rnam pa brgyad de/ /ā ī ū ṝ e ai o au rnams so/ /gsum gyi tshad ni shin tu ring po yin la/ de ni rnam pa dgu ste ring po brgyad po'i mthar/ gsum gyi aṃ ga btags pa brgyad dang*/ dgu pa l̥'o/ /dper na ā gsum ī gsum ū gsum zhes bya ba nas l̥̄ zhes bya ba la sogs pa lta bu'o/ /de ltar na dbyangs nyi shu rtsa gnyis so/ /yi ge 'ba' zhig brjod pa mi gsal ba de ni/ gsal byed ces bya'o | | de'ang bsdu na ka la sogs pa sde tshan lngas bsdus pa'i nyi shu rtsa lnga dang*/ ya la sogs pa mthar gnas bzhi dang*/ sha la sogs pa dro ba bzhi ste/ sum cu rtsa gsum dang*/ a klad kor can dang*/ a tsheg drag can dang*/ /ྈྐ lce rtsa can dang | ྉྤ ( ¡¶ lu ¡· + mchu can ste ) bzhi bsnan pas sum cu rtsa bdun no/ /de ltar dbyangs dang gsal byed thams cad bsdoms na lnga bcu rtsa dgu yin no/ / tshigs su bcad pa'i yi ge bsngo ba na dbyangs bgrang gi gsal byed ni ma yin no | | de skad du/ gsal byed rnams ni sum cu bdun/ /'dir ni dbyangs yig nyi shu gnyis/ /de ltar yi ge lnga bcu dgu/ /dbyangs kyi yi ge bgrang bar bya/ / zhes 'byung bas so/ /'di las gzhan du bshad pa ni/ /'khrul pa yin par shes par byos/ /smra sgo las/ 'grims dang klod la ring po med/ /ces 'don pa ltar na | l̥ la ring po med par 'chad pa de ni paṇ+ḍi tas brjod pa'i don yi ge pas nor bar bris pa yin no/ /'dir sgra'i bstan bcos ka lā pa dang tsan+d+ra pa dang pā ṇi ni la sogs pa dang*/ sdeb sbyor gyi bstan bcos rin chen 'byung gnas la sogs pa mtha' dag las ¡Ã l̥ la ring po med mod kyi/ /ṛ la gsum ka tshang bar yod ( ¡¶ zha ¡· ṛ la ring po med mod kyi/ /l̥ la gsum ga tshang bar yod/

/ ) par bshad do/ / sdeb sbyor byed pas tshigs bcad la/ /lci dang yang dang ngal bso dang*/ /yi ge ming dang rgyan la sogs/ /rnam par bkod pas yid 'phrog byed/ /legs par sbyar ba'i rjes su 'brang ba'i tshigs su bcad pa sbyor ba rnams kyis/ dbyangs thung ngu la yang ba dang la zhes brda btags nas/ prastā ra 'bri ba na/ ri mo drang por 'bri'o/ /rkang pa mtha' ma'i dbyangs thung ngu phal cher lci bar yang 'gyur la | gzhan mtshungs nas brtsams te sdeb sbyor 'ga' zhig de lta ma yin yang*/ mnyam pa'i rkang pa'i mtha' dang*/ dbang po rdo rje la sogs pa mi mnyam pa'i tshig gi mtha' rnams la de ltar yin no/ /dbyangs spangs pa'i gsal byed la/ thog ma'i thung ngu de yang lci ba'o/ /ring po dang shin tu ring po ni lci ba yin zhing*/ sdeb sbyor bas ga zhes 'ga' zhig tu brdar 'dogs la/ prastā ra 'bri ba na ri mo 'khyog por 'bri'o/ /de skad du sgra pa dag gis/ sbyar ba'i thog mar gang 'gyur dang | | tsheg drag can dang thig le can/ /tshig mtha' ring po'i yi ge yang*/ / 'di dag lci bar bstan pa yin/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar ro/ /prastā ra dgod pa'i mdo yang*/ ma gsum lci ba na gsum yang*/ /bha thog lci ba ya thog yang*/ /dza dbus lci ba ra dbus yang*/ /sa mtha' lci ba ta mtha' yang*/ /ngal bso ba ni tshigs su bcad pa 'don pa'i gnas kyi bye brag ste/ gnas dang*/ sdod dang*/ 'jog ces bya ba ni rnam grangs so/ /yi ge ni rjes su mtshungs pa dang*/ mi mtshungs pa la sogs pa'o/ /ming ni 'dod rgyal ba dang*/ rjes sgrub la sogs pa'o | | rgyan ni tshig dang/ don dang*/ dpe la sogs pa'o/ /gzhan yang bsres pa dang*/ yi ge dang*/ ming dang*/ tshig bsgyur ba la sogs pa yin no/ /'di dag gi rnam gzhag rgyas par kho bos byas pa'i mkhas pa rnams 'jug pa'i sgor gsal la/ bye brag tu ngal bso ba'i gnas la sogs pa 'ga' zhig bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs rje la bskul bar bltas pas rnam pa tsam 'char bar 'gyur ro/

/dpe'i phyogs 'ga' tsam yang*/ legs par bshad pa rin po che'i gter du bshad pa lta bu'o/ /bha la sogs pa brgyad kyi tha mar u'i yi ge byung na ngal bso ba'i brda yin la/ lci ba la ngal bso na wa'i yi ge dang*/ yang ba la ngal bso na ka'i ming du 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten pa la yang ngal bso ste/ gcod pa'i rnam gzhag yod do zhes bshad do/ /de ltar shes nas tshigs su bcad pa la 'jug pa na/ tshigs su bcad pa la rnam pa gnyis yod pa las/ thog mar 'phel ba zhes bya ba yi ge bgrang ba de bshad par bya'o/ /de'ang rnam pa gsum ste | mnyam dang phyed mnyam mi mnyam pas/ /'phel ba de yang rnam pa gsum/ / mnyam pa dang*/ phyed mnyam pa dang*/ mi mnyam pa zhes bya ba rnam pa gsum yod pa las/ thog mar mnyam pa'i 'phel ba bshad par bya'o/ /rkang pa dang po'i sdeb sbyor ltar/ /rkang bzhi mtshungs na mnyam pa yin/ /mnyam pa'i 'phel ba thams cad la/ rkang pa dang po'i sdeb sbyor ji lta bar rkang pa lhag ma gsum ka yang de dang mtshungs na mnyam pa yin no/ /de dag so sor bshad na/ yi ge gcig nas lnga yi bar/ /tshigs su bcad par grags mod kyi/ /mkhas pa phal cher de bsgrub pa'i/ /mtshan nyid dbye ba btang snyoms mdzad/ /sngon gyi rabs las grags pa yi ge gcig gi tshigs bcad la brjod pa/ gnyis pa la shin tu brjod pa/ gsum pa la lhan cig bar ma/ bzhi pa la rab gnas/ lnga pa la legs par rab gnas/ zhes 'dod do/ /de skad du/ brjod dang shin tu brjod par ma/ /rab gnas legs par rab gnas dang*/ /dbyangs sgrogs rab dga' go rim bzhin/ /dmar ser gyis ni bshad pa yin/ /ces sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas las 'byung ngo*/ /de dag gi bye brag gi dbye ba la/ yi ge gcig pa'i tshigs su bcad pa'i bye brag ni dpal zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ dbyangs can dang*/ brtan pa'o/ /gsum pa ni lcags sgrog go /bzhi pa la gnyis te/ nor rgyun dang*/ 'byor ldan no/ /lnga pa la gnyis te/

ral gri'i bu dang*/ pi wang ngo*/ /tshig rkang lnga pa yan chad pa'i ming 'di rnams slob dpon rtag pa'i ¡Ã sdes ( ¡¶ zha ¡· rdo rjes ) / rje btsun sgrol ma la bstod pa bṛt+ta mā la zhes bya ba'i rjes su 'brangs nas bshad la/ 'di rnams kyi tha snyad 'ga' zhig mi 'dra ba slob dpon dz+nyā na shrī mi tras 'phags pa 'jam dpal la bstod pa/ bṛt+ta mā la zhes bya ba nas kyang 'byung mod kyi/ yi ge mangs pas 'jigs pas ma bris so | | de dag phyogs tsam dper bya ba/ kho bo'i rje btsun dpal ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs la bstod par sbyar na/ yi ge gcig pa'i tshigs bcad/ blo/ /mchog / dpal | | dbyangs/ /yi ge gnyis pa la/ dbyangs can/ khyod bsgrubs/ / spobs pa/ /brtan thob/ /yi ge gsum pa la/ khyod kyi gsung*/ /gnyis med blo | | lcags sgrog gis/ /sbrel legs 'dra/ /yi ge bzhi pa la/ rgyal sras dbang po/ /'jam dbyangs khyod kyis/ /legs bshad nor rgyun/ /bdag blo tshim mdzad/ /yi ge lnga pa la/ brtse ldan khyod kyi gsung*/ /dri za'i pi wang ltar/ / snyan cing 'jebs pa yis/ /gdul bya'i yid 'phrog byed/ /ces pa lta bu ste/ sngon chad ma thos pa rnams la sdeb sbyor gyi dga' ston dgye ba'i phyir bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /slob dpon rin chen 'byung gnas ni yi ge drug pa man chad la/ tshigs su bcad pa mtshan nyid par bzhed de/ tshigs bcad rnams la mkhas phyir drug pa nas brtsams te re re spel ba'i rkang pa bya/ zhes 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /des na 'dir de'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ yi ge drug pa nas brtsams te/ /yi ge re re spel ba la/ /ngal bso ba dang lci yang gi /rab tu dbye bas tshigs bcad 'grub/ /tshigs su bcad pa 'di rnams la yang*/ spyi'i ming dang*/ bye brag gi dbye ba gnyis gnyis yod pa las/ thog mar spyi yi ming brjod pa/ dbyangs sgrogs rab dga' rjes su bsngags/ /bṛ ha ti dang phreng ldan dang | | gsum bsngags yan chad rkyang pa yin/

/yi ge drug pa dbyangs sgrogs/ bdun pa rab dga'/ brgyad pa rjes su bsngags pa/ dgu pa bṛ ha ti/ bcu pa phreng ldan/ bcu gcig pa gsum bsngags te/ de dag rkyang pa yin no/ /skye 'gro man chad shin tu la/ /sogs pas 'phangs pa'i rkang pa can/ /nyi shu drug gi bar du bzhed/ /yi ge bcu gnyis pa skye 'gro/ bcu gsum pa shin tu skye 'gro/ bcu bzhi pa nus ldan/ bco lnga pa shin tu nus ldan/ bcu drug pa legs spyod/ bcu bdun pa shin tu legs spyod/ bco brgyad pa brtan 'dzin/ bcu dgu pa shin tu brtan 'dzin/ nyi shu pa byed ldan/ nyi shu rtsa gcig pa shin tu byed ldan/ nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa kun byed/ nyi shu rtsa gsum pa rnam byed/ nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa legs byed/ nyi shu rtsa lnga pa shin tu legs byed/ nyi shu rtsa drug pa lhag par legs byed ces bya'o | | rkang pa can zhes bya ba ni tshigs su bcad pa zhes bya ba'i don to/ /yi ge nyi shu rtsa bdun pa nas rgyun chags pa'i bye brag tu 'gyur ro/ /'di'i cha rig byed kyi gzhung lugs las kyang 'di skad 'don te/ rig byed la rwa bzhi/ 'di'i rkang pa gsum/ mgo gnyis/ lag pa bdun/ de 'dir gsum nas bcings na/ khyu mchog 'di ni nga ro 'don/ /zhes bya ste/ rwa bzhi ni rig byed bzhi/ mgo gnyis ni | oṃ dang dbyangs kyi sdeb sbyor/ lag pa bdun ni sdeb sbyor bdun te/ drug pa dbyangs sgrogs ni dus drug bdun pa rab dga' ni drang srong bdun/ brgyad pa rjes su bsngags pa ni nor lha brgyad/ dgu pa bṛ ha ti ni gza' dgu/ bcu pa phreng ldan ni phyogs skyong bcu/ bcu gcig pa gsum bsngags ni drag po bcu gcig bcu gnyis pa skye 'gro ni nyi ma bcu gnyis/ snying ga dang*/ mgrin pa dang/ mgo bo gsum/ ngag khyu mchog gi yi ge oṃ/ rkang pa gsum ni sby-in sreg grong pa lho phyogs kyi me gsum/ yang me lce bdun pa zhes kyang bshad de/ de ltar na sdeb sbyor 'di dag rang byung skyes bus ma byas par 'dod do/

/de ltar spyi'i ming brjod nas/ bye brag gi ¡Ã mtshan nyid ( ¡¶ zha ¡· dbye ba ) brjod na/ yi ge drug pa dbyangs sgrogs kyi bye brag la/ ta ya gsum sdod dbus phra yin/ /ta dang ya gnyis la yi ge gsum gsum la ngal bso ba yod na dbus phra zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /de dang mtshan nyid mi 'dra ba 'ga' zhig la chu srin mgo zhes kyang bstan bcos gzhan nas bshad do/ /bdun pa rab dga'i bye brag la/ /gzhon nu rol pa dza sa lci/ /dza dang sa'i mthar lci ba gcig yod na gzhon nu rol pa zhes bya'o/ /brgyad pa rjes su bsngags pa'i bye brag la/ lci yang bzhir bsgres 'dra mtshungs te/ /lci ba'i yi ge dang yang ba'i yi ge sbyar ba lan bzhir bsgres pas yi ge brgyad du byung ba ni/ /'dra mtshungs so/ /yang lci bzhi pa gzhal dpag yin | | snga ma las bzlog pa yi ge brgyad pa gzhal dpag go /bha gnyis lci ba gnyis rkang bkra /bha gnyis kyi mthar lci ba'i yi ge gnyis sbrel ba ni rkang pa bkra ba zhes bya'o/ /ma gnyis lci ba zung glog phreng*/ /ma gnyis kyi mthar snga ma bzhin lci ba gnyis sbyar ba ni glog gi phreng ba'o/ /bha ta yang lci bram ze'i bu/ / bha dang ta'i mthar yang ba dang lci ba'i yi ge yod na bram ze'i phru gu zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /'di la dmar ser gyis bram ze'i phru gu rtsen pa zhes btags so/ / bstan bcos gzhan las yi ge mnyam la mtshan nyid mi 'dra ba 'ga' la yod tan zhes bya ba dang*/ pad+ma can dang*/ phan byed dang*/ lo 'dab ces bya ba'i sdeb sbyor yang yod do/ /dgu pa bṛ ha ta'i bye brag la/ ra na sa ni gshol gdong yin// ra dang na dang sa rnams legs par sbrel ba ni gshol gdong ngo*/ /na na ma ni ltos 'gro'i bu/ /na gnyis dang ma sbrel ba ni/ ltos 'gro phru gu 'gro zhes grags so | | gzhan las zur gyis lta zhes bya ba dang*/ phyag rgya zhes bya ba mtshan nyid tha dad pa yang bshad do/ /bcu pa phreng ldan la/

ma sa dza ga dag par snang*/ /ma dang sa dang dza'i mthar lci ba gcig yod na dag pa'i snang ba zhes 'dod do/ /ma na ya lci ba ṇa ba/ /ma dang na dang ya'i mthar lci ba'i yi ge gcig yod na/ ¡Ã rnga ba ( ¡¶ zha ¡· pa ¡¶ lu ¡· - rnga ba ) ṇa ba zhes bya bar 'gyur te/ de'i sgra dang mtshungs par grags pa'i phyir ro/ /ra dza ra ga rma bya'i 'gros/ /ra dang dza dang ra'i mthar lci ba gcig yod na rma bya'i 'gros zhes bya'o/ /bha ma sa ga gser ldan 'gyur/ /bha dang ma dang sa'i mthar lci ba gcig ( ¡¶ zha ¡· - gcig ) yod na gser ldan no/ /ma bha sa ga myos ma yin/ /ma dang bha dang sa'i mthar lci ba gcig yod na myos ma'o/ / gzhan las na ( ¡¶ zha ¡· ni ) li ni/ bzang ldan gtso/ tsam pa'i phreng ba/ sprin gyi bla re | bde blag byed ces 'don pa yang yod do/ /bcu gcig pa gsum bsngags la | ta dza dza ga ga nyer 'khod/ /ta dang dza gnyis dang lci ba gnyis yod na nyer 'khod ces bya'o/ /ta gnyis dza mthar lci ba gnyis/ /dbang po rdo rje'i tshigs bcad yin/ /ta dang ta dang dza'i mthar lci ba'i yi ge gnyis yod na dbang po rdo rje zhes grags so/ /dza ta dza mthar lci ba gnyis/ /sdeb sbyor nye dbang rdo rjer 'dod | | dza dang ta dang dza'i mthar lci ba gnyis yod na/ nye dbang rdo rje zhes bya'o | | rdo rje rnam gnyis bsres pa la/ /nyer bskyed zhes byar dran dbang 'dod | | dbang po rdo rje dang nye dbang rdo rje gnyis bsres pa la nyer bskyed ces dran pa'i dbang po rnams 'dod de/ 'di las rab tu dbye ba mang du'ang 'byung ngo | | bha gsum ga gnyis bsdebs pa la/ /'jo ba po zhes tshig mkhan 'dod/ / bha gsum gyi mthar mar lci ba gnyis sbyar ba la 'jo ba pau zhes snyan ngag mkhan rnams 'dod do/ /ma lci ra gnyis ci rig byed/ /ri la 'jog ( ¡¶ zha ¡· 'dzeg ) pa sā li ni/ /ma'i mthar lci ba gcig dang*/ ra gnyis kyi mthar lci ba gcig sbyar ba la bzhi dang bdun pa la ngal bso na sā li ni zhes bya'o/

/ma lci sa ra lci sngon bzhin | | ngal bso rlung gi dba' rlabs phreng*/ /ma'i mthar lci ba gcig dang*/ sa dang ra'i mthar lci ba gcig sbyar ba la sā li ni ltar bzhi dang*/ bdun la ngal bso na rlung gi dba' rlabs phreng zhes bya'o/ /rgyal ba'i lha ni rlung gi dba' rlabs zhes 'dod do/ /ma lci na gnyis lci sngon bzhin/ /'jog pa bung pa rol pa yin/ /ma'i mthar lci ba gcig dang na gnyis kyi mthar lci ba gcig yod la/ sngar bzhin bzhi dang*/ bdun la ngal bso na bung ba rol pa zhes bya ba'i sdeb sbyor du 'gyur ro/ /ra na ra mthar yang dang lci/ /sngar bzhin ngal bso shing rta dregs | | ra dang na dang ra'i mthar yang ba gcig dang lci ba gcig sbyar ba'i bzhi pa dang bdun pa la ngal bso ba ni shing rta dregs zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ / ra na bha mthar lci dang lci/ /legs par sbyar ba legs 'ongs yin/ /ra dang na dang bha'i mthar lci ba gnyis sbyar ba'i tshigs su bcad pa ni legs 'ongs zhes bya'o | | na gnyis sa mthar lci ba zung*/ /sdeb legs de ni zlum por bzhed/ /na gnyis dang sa'i mthar lci ba gnyis sbyar nas legs par bsdebs na zlum po zhes bya'o/ /na na ra mthar yang dang lci/ /sbyar ba'i sdeb sbyor bzang ldan yin/ /

na gnyis dang ra'i mthar yang ba gcig dang lci ba gcig sbyar na bzang ldan zhes bya'o/ /ra dza ra rjes yang dang lci/ /sbyar ba khra zhes blo dbang 'dod/ /ra dang dza dang ra'i mthar yang ba gcig dang lci ba gcig sbyar na bya khra zhes mkhas pa rnams 'dod/ dza sa ta mthar lci ba zung*/ /sbyar ba nye bar gnas zhes zer/ /dza dang sa dang ta'i mthar lci ba gnyis yod na nye gnas zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ / bstan bcos gzhan las ni/ de dag dang yi ge mnyam la mtshan nyid mi 'dra ba 'ga' zhig la kun tu bzang ldan dang*/ gnas su phyin pa dang*/ khang bzangs ldan zhes 'don pa yang yod do/ /yi ge bcu gnyis pa skye 'gro la ( ¡¶ lu ¡· + phya ) / ra na bha sa zla ba'i lam/ /ra dang na dang bha dang sa yod na zla ba'i lam zhes bya'o/ / dza ta dza ra rgyud gnas yin/ /dza dang ta dang dza dang ra rnams gang la yod pa'i sdeb sbyor ni rgyud gnas zhes bya'o/ /ta ta dza ra dbang po'i rgyud/ /ta gnyis dang dza dang ra yod pa'i sdeb sbyor ni/ dbang po'i rgyud ces bya'o/ /na gnyis lci gnyis ra lci ba/ /brgyad bzhir sdod na kha sbyor yin/ /na gnyis dang lci ba gnyis dang ra'i mthar lci ba gcig yod la/ thog ma yi ge ¡Ã brgyad dang*/ de nas yi ge ( ¡¶ zha ¡· - brgyad dang*/ de nas yi ge ) bzhi pa la ngal bso na kha sbyor zhes bya'o// dza su ( ¡¶ zha ¡· sa ) lan gnyis drug pa la/ /ngal bso ba ni chu 'thor 'gro /dza dang sa dang dza dang sa la yi ge drug pa'i gnas su ngal bso na chu 'thor 'gro'o/ /sa bzhi sbrel ba to ṭa ka /sa'i yi ge lan bzhir sbrel ba ni to ṭa ka'o/ /na bha bha ra dal myur yin/ /na dang bha gnyis dang ra'i yi ge sbyar ba ni dal myur zhes bya'o// ya bzhi ltos 'phye rab tu ltung*/ /ya bzhi sbrel ba ni ltos 'phye rab tu ltung ba zhes bya'o | | me tog phreng rgyud rab bzhi pa/ /ra bzhi sbrel ba'i sdeb sbyor ni/ /me tog phreng rgyud ces bya'o/ /sa dza sa gnyis yi ge nyung*/ /sa dang dza dang sa gnyis yod pa'i sdeb sbyor ni yi ge nyung ngu zhes bya'o/

/ma lci lci ba ra gnyis lci/ /mda' ri ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· + ltar ) ngal bso sna tshogs lha/ /ma'i yi ge'i mthar lci ba gnyis dang ra gnyis kyi mthar lci ba gcig yod cing*/ yi ge lnga pa dang de nas bdun pa la ngal bso na sna tshogs lha mo zhes bya'o/ /ma lci na yang lci ba gnyis/ /bzhi brgyad 'jog pa chu 'dzin phreng*/ /ma'i mthar lci ba gcig ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· gnyis ) dang na dang ya'i mthar lci ba gnyis yod na yi ge bzhi pa dang brgyad pa la ngal bso na chu 'dzin phreng ba zhes bya'o/ /na gnyis ra ra dal gyis 'bab/ /na gnyis dang ra gnyis sbrel ba ni lha'i chu dal gyis 'bab pa dang*/ mtshungs pa'i phyir de skad ces bya'o/ /na dza dza ra ya mu na/ /na'i mthar dza gnyis dang ra gcig yod pa ni/ chu klung ya mu na dang mtshungs pa'i phyir sdeb sbyor gyi ming de skad ces bya'o/ /na dza bha ya phreng ba gsar/ /na dang dza dang bha dang ya bsgrigs te bsdebs pa ni phreng ba gsar ldan zhes bya'o/ /sdeb sbyor gyi bstan bcos gzhan las ni/ ngag gi dbang phyug rtsen pa/ kun+da'i 'khri shing*/ sna tshogs can/ 'dod ster/ rol pa can | zur sbyor/ ri dwags mchongs/ zhes bya ba'i sdeb sbyor du 'dod pa yang mthong ngo*// //yi ge bcu gsum pa shin tu skye 'gro la phye na/ mu ( ¡¶ zha ¡· ma ) na dza ra lci yon tan/ /phyogs su sdod par rab spro ma/ /ma dang na dang dza dang ra'i mthar lci ba gcig yod cing*/ yi ge gsum pa dang bcu pa'i gnas su sdod pa ni rab tu dga' ldan zhes bya'o/ /dza lci na dza ra chu gter/ /dgu la ngal bso dga' mdzes yin | | dza'i mthar lci ba gcig dang na dang dza dang ra rnams bsdebs pa yi ge bzhi pa dang dgu pa gnas su ngal bso ba ni dga' mdzes zhes bya bar grags so | | ma lci bha ta ya sngon bzhin/ /myos pa'i rma bya ngal bso'o/ /ma dang lci ba gcig gi mthar/ bha dang rta dang ya yod cing snga ma dga' mdzes ltar chu gter dang dgu la ngal bso ba ni/

so ga'i dus kyi rma bya'i dbyangs dang mtshungs pa'i phyir myos pa'i rma bya zhes bya'o/ /sa dza sa gnyis lci ba gcig /yid 'ong ngang pa'i sdeb sbyor yin/ / ¡Ã sa dang dza dang yang sa gnyis kyi mthar lci ba gcig yod na/ ngang pa'i rgyal po gshog pa khra bo'i ro ( ri mo ) dang mtshungs pa'i phyir yid du 'ong ba zhes bya ste/ 'dab bkra ngang pa zhes kyang byar rung ngo*/ /sa dza gnyis ldabs mthar lci ba/ /tshigs su bcad pa 'jam pa'i ngag /sa dang dza dang yang sa dang dza'i mthar lci ba gcig yod na/ sdeb sbyor de ni 'jam pa'i ngag ces mkhas pa rnams la grags so/ /bstan bcos gzhan las 'od ldan zhes bya ba dang*/ mngag gzhug ces 'don pa yod do// //yi ge bcu bzhi pa nus ldan la phye na/ ma mthar lci gnyis na gnyis ma/ / rkang ldan de ni gnod med yin/ /ma'i yi ge'i mthar lci ba gnyis dang na gnyis kyi mthar ma'i yi ge gcig yod na rkang ldan de la ming gnod med ces grags so | | rkang ldan ni tshigs su bcad pa zhes bya ba'i don to/ /na gnyis lci mthar dza gnyis lci/ /bdun 'jog gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ /na gnyis kyi mthar lci ba gcig yod cing dza gnyis kyi mthar lci ba gcig yod la yi ge bdun pa'i gnas su ngal bso na gzhan gyis mi thub pa zhes bya ba'i rkang ldan du 'gyur ro/ /na gnyis lci ba lan gnyis bsgyur/ /mtshon cha kha 'bus bdun par 'dod/ /na gnyis kyi mthar lci ba gcig yod la slar yang na gnyis kyi mthar lci ba gcig yod na/ snga ma ltar yi ge bdun pa'i gnas su ngal bso na mtshon cha kha 'bus zhes bya'o/ /ta bha dza gnyis lci ba gnyis/ /dpyid kyi thig le rkang bzhi pa/ /ta dang bha'i mthar dza gnyis dang lci ba gnyis sbrel ba ni dpyid kyi thig le zhes bya'o | | rkang pa bzhi pa ni tshigs su bcad pa zhes bya ba'i rnam grangs so/ /sa mthar yang lci na ra gnyis/ /mda' dang gzar sdod nor 'dzin yin/ /sa'i mthar yang ba'i yi ge gcig dang lci ba'i gcig dang na dang de nas ra'i yi ge gnyis sbrel nas/

yi ge lnga pa dang dgu pa'i gnas su ngal bso ba'i rkang bzhi pa ni nor 'dzin ces bya'o/ /bstan bcos gzhan las kun+da can/ sha ra bha/ lha nyid ces bya ba mtshan nyid gzhan pa yang snang ngo*// //yi ge bco lnga pa shin tu nus ldan la phye na/ yang ba bcu bzhi sbrel ba'i mthar | | gcig lci ri bong can gyi cha/ /yang ba'i yi ge bcu bzhi'i mthar lci ba gcig sbyar nas bar du ngal bso ba'i gnas med pa ni/ ri bong can gyi cha zhes grags so/ /de nyid ro dang gza' gnas su/ /ngal bso ba ni me tog phreng*/ /ri bong can gyi cha'i sdeb sbyor de nyid la yi ge drug pa dang dgu pa'i gnas su ngal bso na me tog phreng ba zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /de nyid nor lha thub pa ru/ / gnas pa yon tan nor bu'i tshogs/ /snga ma'i sdeb sbyor de nyid la/ yi ge brgyad pa dang bdun par ngal bso na yon tan nor bu'i tshogs zhes bya bar sdeb sbyor mkhan rnams la grags so/ /na gnyis lci gnyis ra gnyis lci/ /nor dang ri 'jog phreng ldan ma/ /na gnyis dang lci ba gnyis dang ( ¡¶ lu ¡· - sa dang gnyis dang ) ra gnyis kyi mthar lci ba gcig yod pa'i rkang pa can la/ yi ge brgyad pa dang bdun par ngal bso ba ni phreng ldan ma zhes bya'o/ /na dza bha dza ra sbrel legs/ /rgya mtsho zhes bya'i tshig ldan yin/ /na dang dza dang bha dang dza dang ra rnams tshig mkhan gyis bsdebs legs par gyur na rgya mtsho zhes bya ba'i sdeb sbyor ro/ /tshigs ldan zhes bya ba'ang tshigs su bcad pa zhes bya ba'i tha tshig go | sdeb sbyor gzhan las lus med/ rnam bsgyings/ 'dod ldan ma/ bde 'gro dga' | nor bu yon tan tshogs zhes 'don pa yang yod do// //yi ge bcu drug pa legs spyod ces bya ba la phye na/ bha ra yang dang na gnyis sa/ /glang chen mchog rtsen ri bug sdod/ /bha dang ra dang de'i mthar yang ba gcig dang de nas na gnyis kyi mthar sa gcig yod cing yi ge bdun pa dang dgu pa la ngal bso na/

khyu mchog glang chen rtsen pa zhes grags so/ /glang chen mchog rtsen zhes sbyar ba ni/ tshigs su bcad pa bsdebs pa'i ngor bas so/ /na dza bha dza ra lci ba/ /le brgan rtsi zhes rgyud mkhan 'dod/ /na dang dza dang bha dang dza dang ra'i mthar lci ba gcig yod na me tog le brgan rtsi zhes 'dod de/ rgyud mkhan ni tshig gi phreng ba rgyud mkhas pa'i phyir sdeb sbyor mkhan no/ /gzhan las ni de dang mtshan nyid mi 'dra ba 'ga' zhig la/ mi g.yo brtan/ ku pa la lo ma bkod pa/ gzhon nu'i rtse 'jo/ dge byed/ rab mchog rol pa zhes grags pa yang yod do// //yi ge bcu bdun pa shin tu legs spyod la phye na/ ya mu na sa bha yang lci// rtse ldan ma ste ro drag sdod/ /ya dang mu ( ¡¶ lu ¡· ma ) dang na dang sa dang bha'i mthar yang ba gcig dang lci ba gcig yod la/ yi ge drug pa dang bcu gcig pa la sdod cing ngal bso na rtse mo can ma zhes bya'o/ /mu'i u ni ngal bso ba'i gnas nges par bya ba'i phyir brda sbyar ba'o/ /dza sa yang lci na ra gnyis/ /yangs ldan nor lha bu gar sdod/ /dza dang sa'i mthar yang ba dang lci ba'i yi ge yod la/ de nas na gcig dang ra'i yi ge gnyis yod cing*/ yi ge brgyad pa dang dgu par ngal bso na yangs ldan zhes bya'o/ /yangs ldan ni sa'i ming gi rnam grangs te/ 'dir sa gzhi zhes bya bar yang rung ngo*/ /de nyid lag pa yon tan dang*/ /tshig mthar sdod na bdud rtsi yin/ /sdeb sbyor snga ma nyid la yi ge gnyis pa dang*/ de nas gsum pa dang*/ de nas tshig rdzogs pa'i gnas su ngal bso na bdud rtsi zhes grags so/ /bha ra na lci na na lci/ /smyug 'dab ltung ba phyogs thub sdod/ / bha dang ra dang na'i mthar lci ba gcig dang yang na gnyis kyi mthar lci ba gcig yod cing yi ge bcu pa dang bdun pa'i gnas su ngal bso na smyug 'dab ltung zhes bya'o/ /na su ma lci dza gnyis lci/ /ro chu dbyangs sdod ri dwags mo/ /na dang sa dang ma dngalci ba gcig dang*/

de nas dza gnyis kyi mthar lci ba gcig yod cing yi ge drug pa dang*/ de nas bzhi pa dang*/ de nas bdun pa la ngal bso na ri dwags mo zhes 'dod do/ /su'i u ni ngal bso ba'i brda'o/ /ma lci na su ra gnyis lci/ /chu dus rir 'jog dal gyis gnon/ /ma'i mthar lci ba dang na dang sa dang ra gnyis dang lci ba ( ¡¶ lu ¡· + gcig ) yod cing*/ yi ge bzhi pa dang*/ de nas drug pa dang*/ de nas bdun pa la ngal bso na dal gyis gnon zhes bya'o/ /na dza lci na bhu ( ¡¶ zha ¡· bha ) bha lci/ /ri ro chur sdod khu byug yin/ /na dang dza'i mthar lci ba dang na dang bha gnyis kyi mthar lci ba gcig yod cing*/ yi ge bdun pa dang drug pa dang bzhi par ngal bso na khu byug ces bya'o/ /gzhan las na rku ṭa dang*/ nor rgyun dang*/ rab dbyangs zhes sbyor ba'ang yod do// //yi ge bco brgyad pa brtan 'dzin la phye na/ ma dang lci gnyis na su ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· sa ) ra/ /ra lci 'khri shing gnas sum sdod/ /ma'i mthar lci ba gnyis dang na dang sa'i mthar ra gnyis dang lci ba gcig yod cing*/ yi ge lnga pa dang*/ drug pa dang*/ bdun par ngal bso ba ni/ me tog g.yo ba'i 'khri shing zhes bya'o// na gnyis ra bzhi sbrel ba la/ /lcags mda' zhes bya'i tshig ldan 'byung*/ /ngal mi bso bar na gnyis dang ra yig bzhi sbrel ba la lcags mda' zhes bya'o// tshig ldan ni tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /sdeb sbyor gzhan las ta ma la'i 'dab ma/ me tog rna rgyan/ tsa ra ( ¡¶ zha ¡· - ra ) tsa ( ¡¶ lu ¡· tsi ) ri/ myos pa'i rtse 'jo zhes grags pa yang yod do// //yi ge bcu dgu pa shin tu brtan 'dzin la phye na/ ya mu na su ra gnyis lci | | dus drug rtar sdod sprin rnam sgrogs/ /ya dang ma dang na dang sa'i mthar ra gnyis dang lci ba gcig yod cing*/ yi ge drug pa dang*/ yang drug pa dang*/ de nas bdun par ngal bso na/ sprin rnam sgrogs zhes bya'o/ /mu dang su'i u ni ngal bso ba'i gnas nges par byas pa'o/

/ma sa dza su ta gnyis lci/ /nyi ma rta la sdod pa stag /rnam par rtsen pa zhes tshig gi lhag mar sbyar ro/ /ma dang sa dang dza dang su dang ta gnyis kyi mthar lci ba yod cing yi ge bcu gnyis pa dang bdun par ngal bso na gcan gzan gtso bo'i rnam par rtsen pa zhes bya'o/ /gcan gzan gtso bo'i sgra seng ge dang stag gnyis la 'jog pa las/ 'dir sha rtu la'i sgra stag la sbyar ro/ /su'i u ni ngal bso ba'o// //yi ge nyi shu pa byed ldan la phye na/ kha mdzes ma ra lci na gnyis/ /lci dang ta su gnas gsum sdod/ /ma dang ra dang de nas lci ba'i mthar na gnyis dang*/ lci ba gcig gi mthar ta dang sa yod cing yi ge bdun pa dang yang bdun pa dang drug pa la ngal bso na kha mdzes zhes bya'o/ /ra dza gsum bsgres lci dang yang*/ / zlum po zhes ni mkhas rnams 'dod/ /ra dang dza lan gsum du bsgres pa'i mthar lci ba'i yi ge gcig dang yang ba gcig byung ba zlum po zhes bya bar 'gyur te | zlum po'i ngang tshul de la yod pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gzhan las ni rol ldan ma dang*/ seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa zhes sbyar ba yang yod do// //nyi shu rtsa gcig pa rab tu byed ldan la phye na/ ma ra na gnyis ra gnyis lci | | bdun par lci sdod phreng rgyud 'dzin/ /ma dang ra'i mthar lci ba gcig dang yang na gnyis kyi mthar lci ba gcig dang yang ra gnyis kyi mthar lci ba gcig yod cing*/ yi ge bdun ( ¡¶ lu ¡· - bdun ) pa gsum gyi gnas su ngal bso na me tog phreng rgyud 'dzin zhes bya'o/ /gzhan las de dang yi ge mnyam la sdeb sbyor mi 'dra ba la mdzes ldan ma zhes 'dod pa yang yod do// //yi ge nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa kun byed la/ bha ra na lci dza su gnyis/ /zab mo'i dbyangs zhes rab tu grags/ /bha ra na'i mthar lci ba gcig dang*/ de nas dza su dza su yod na zab mo'i dbyangs zhes bya ba'i sdeb sbyor ro// //yi ge nyi shu rtsa gsum pa rnam byed la phye na/
